Authors: Jack B. Jedlicki, Amish Sethi, Heng Yang

Phase-Conditioned Affordance Fields for SE(3)-Equivariant Visuomotor Policies Manipulation

SE(3)-equivariance affordance field visuomotor policy manipulation point cloud

简要说明：本文提出了相位条件化可供性场（PAF），通过学习逐点可供性分数将SE(3)等变视觉运动策略锚定到任务相关区域，在多种空间随机化和真实机器人多物体任务中提高了操作成功率。

TLDR: This paper introduces Phase-Conditioned Affordance Fields (PAF), which learn per-point affordance scores to anchor SE(3)-equivariant visuomotor policies around task-relevant regions, improving manipulation success across varying spatial randomizations and real-robot multi-object tasks.

Abstract: SE(3)-equivariance provides a useful geometric inductive bias for visuomotor policies, encoding that actions covary with rigid transformations of the observation. However, existing SE(3)-equivariant visuomotor policies build this bias on a global equivariance assumption that treats the entire observation as governed by a single rigid transformation, which breaks down in real-world manipulation tasks where the task-relevant region changes across different objects. We address this by learning a phase-conditioned affordance field (PAF) over the observed point cloud, a per-point score that the SE(3)-equivariant policy uses in two complementary ways. Its score-weighted centroid serves as a learned, phase-conditioned anchor that canonicalizes the observation and the action around the active region, replacing the fixed gripper-frame reference, and the score itself is appended as a per-point feature. This introduces a local geometric inductive bias, while preserving the policy's global SE(3) equivariance. We validate on multiple MimicGen tasks under varying spatial randomization, and PAF consistently improves the success rate of the underlying policy. On multi-object real-robot tasks, PAF outperforms baselines and keeps its lead under lighting variations.

摘要（中文）：SE(3)-等变性为视觉运动策略提供了一种有用的几何归纳偏置，编码了动作随观察的刚体变换而协同变化的特性。然而，现有的SE(3)-等变视觉运动策略将这种偏置建立在全局等变性假设之上，该假设将整个观察视为由单一刚体变换支配，这在真实世界的操作任务中会失效，因为任务相关区域在不同物体之间会发生变化。我们通过在学习到的点云上引入相位条件化可供性场（PAF）来解决这一问题，该场为每个点提供一个得分，SE(3)-等变策略以两种互补方式使用该得分。其得分加权质心作为一个学习得到的、相位条件化的锚点，用于围绕活动区域对观察和动作进行规范化，取代固定的夹爪框架参考，同时该得分本身也被附加为逐点特征。这引入了一种局部几何归纳偏置，同时保留了策略的全局SE(3)等变性。我们在多种空间随机化条件下的多个MimicGen任务上进行了验证，PAF持续提高了底层策略的成功率。在多物体真实机器人任务中，PAF优于基线方法，并在光照变化下保持其领先优势。

Authors: Xinzhe Chen, Liqi Huang, Sihua Ren, Haowen Sun, Mingyang Li, Zeyang Liu, Xingyu Chen, Xuguang Lan

LiDAR-based Humanoid Navigation in Dynamic, Non-Convex Environments via Spatio-Temporal Safe Corridors HumanoidEmbodied

LiDAR spatio-temporal safe corridors humanoid navigation Dynamic Non-Convex Environments Linear Inverted Pendulum (LIP)

简要说明：本文提出了一种基于LiDAR的人形机器人实时导航框架，通过构建时空安全走廊来处理动态非凸障碍物，在Digit人形机器人仿真中实现了高成功率。

TLDR: This paper presents a real-time LiDAR-based navigation framework for humanoid robots that constructs spatio-temporal safe corridors to handle dynamic, non-convex obstacles, achieving high success in simulations with the Digit humanoid.

Abstract: Navigating humanoid robots through dynamic, non-convex environments requires tightly coupling onboard perception with footstep planning and dynamic locomotion control. Existing methods frequently discard complex free space through simplified convex obstacle bounds and fail to account for real-time dynamic occupancy predictions. This paper presents a real-time framework for humanoid navigation that directly constructs spatio-temporal safe corridors from LiDAR-based particle representations and couples them with Linear Inverted Pendulum (LIP)-based planning and Whole Body Control (WBC) to enable navigation around and within moving non-convex structures without restrictive geometric assumptions. Simulations on the Digit humanoid yield a 96% success rate in navigating around and inside moving non-convex obstacles in a 24 by 24 m^2 arena. Ablation studies confirm that the proposed iterative polytope generation significantly outperforms single-iteration baselines in narrow corridors, while evaluations demonstrate robustness to clutter, sensor noise, control delays, and force perturbations.

摘要（中文）：在动态、非凸环境中导航类人机器人，需要将机载感知与落脚点规划和动态运动控制紧密耦合。现有方法常通过简化的凸障碍边界丢弃复杂的自由空间，且未能考虑实时动态占用预测。本文提出一种实时类人导航框架，直接从基于激光雷达的粒子表示构建时空安全走廊，并将其与基于线性倒立摆（LIP）的规划及全身控制（WBC）相结合，从而在无需严格几何假设的情况下，实现绕行及穿越移动的非凸结构。在Digit类人机器人上的仿真实验中，该框架在24米×24米的区域内绕行及穿越移动非凸障碍的成功率达到96%。消融研究证实，在狭窄走廊中，所提出的迭代多面体生成方法显著优于单次迭代基线方法；同时，评估结果表明该方法对杂乱环境、传感器噪声、控制延迟及外力扰动具有鲁棒性。

Authors: Shubham S. Kumbhar, Panagiotis Artemiadis

ABot-ER: Unified Embodied Reasoning through Agentic Data-Model Co-Evolution VLA

embodied reasoning foundation model agentic data-model co-evolution task-conditioned adaptive training point grounding

简要说明：ABot-ER提出一个统一的具身推理基础模型，通过智能体数据-模型协同进化引擎和任务条件低秩残差适配，在感知、规划与执行三大能力上实现SOTA性能。

TLDR: ABot-ER introduces a unified embodied reasoning foundation model that jointly masters perception, planning, and execution via an agentic data-model co-evolution engine and task-conditioned low-rank residual adaptation, achieving state-of-the-art results across twelve benchmarks.

Abstract: We introduce ABot Embodied Reasoning (ABot-ER), a unified embodied reasoning foundation model that breaks the tension between breadth and depth in embodied reasoning. Embodied intelligence demands the joint mastery of perception, planning, and execution, yet reconciling generality with specialization across this spectrum remains an open challenge. Within a single unified model, ABot-ER commands specialist-level depth across all three competencies, spanning spatial, scene, and temporal reasoning in perception; long-horizon action organization in planning; and point grounding and affordance in execution. The Agentic Data-Model Self-Evolution Engine continuously adapts data strategies to the model's evolving capability state. The Task-Conditioned Adaptive Training Strategy uses task tokens to activate lightweight low-rank residuals over a shared backbone, separating updates from heterogeneous output formats while retaining shared embodied knowledge. Across a systematic evaluation on twelve benchmarks covering three core competencies and five capability dimensions, ABot-ER achieves state-of-the-art overall performance across perception, planning, and execution within a unified parametric framework, demonstrating that breadth and depth can coexist in unified embodied reasoning.

摘要（中文）：我们推出ABot具身推理（ABot-ER），一个统一的具身推理基础模型，打破了具身推理中广度与深度之间的张力。具身智能要求对感知、规划和执行三者的联合掌握，然而在这一范围内调和通用性与专精性仍然是一个开放挑战。在单一统一模型中，ABot-ER在全部三种能力上拥有专家级深度，涵盖感知中的空间、场景和时间推理；规划中的长时程行动组织；以及执行中的点定位与可供性。智能体数据-模型自进化引擎持续根据模型不断变化的能力状态调整数据策略。任务条件自适应训练策略利用任务令牌在共享骨干网络上激活轻量级低秩残差，将更新与异构输出格式分离，同时保留共享的具身知识。在对涵盖三种核心能力和五个能力维度的十二个基准系统评估中，ABot-ER在统一参数框架内，于感知、规划和执行方面均取得整体最先进的性能，表明在统一具身推理中广度与深度可以共存。

Authors: Qiuyu Ding, Heng-Da Xu, Changda Xia, Jiajun Shen, Zihao Guan, Zhengchen Yuan, Jianfang Zhang, Di Yang, Jiayi Tian, Yuting Xu, Fei Wang, Shiao Liu, Wei Zhang, Xiaolong Wu, Wenbin Tang, Zedong Chu, Mu Xu

LongForcing: Scaling Temporal Manifold Matching for Long-Horizon World Rollout WorldModel

world model long-horizon rollout distribution matching autoregressive video diffusion distillation

简要说明：本文提出LongForcing，一种将教师监督扩展到学生自回归长序列推演的知识蒸馏方法，用于视频扩散世界模型，通过延长监督视野减少漂移，提升文本到视频及动作条件交互生成的长时间稳定性。

TLDR: This paper introduces LongForcing, a distillation method that scales teacher supervision to long student self-rollouts for autoregressive video diffusion world models, reducing drift and improving long-horizon rollout quality in text-to-video and action-conditioned interactive generation.

Abstract: Autoregressive video diffusion models have emerged as a foundation for long-horizon world rollout. However, when extended far beyond their training windows, these models suffer from progressive drift: visual quality deteriorates, motion becomes inconsistent, and object identity gradually collapses as generated frames are recursively reused as context. We study a supervision-horizon gap: short-horizon distillation leaves later rollout states without direct supervision. We show that matching short-window marginals need not determine long-horizon behavior, while longer on-policy trajectories expose delayed failures to training. This motivates temporal manifold matching at scale for long-horizon world models. Building on this insight, we introduce LongForcing, a distillation approach that scales teacher supervision to long student self-rollouts. LongForcing preserves the short-horizon teacher-forcing and causal ODE-distillation stages, while replacing the realscore teacher in the final distribution-matching stage with an extended-horizon bidirectional teacher. The long-horizon teacher supervises extended student self-rollouts using the standard distribution-matching formulation, without modifying the student architecture or increasing inference cost. We evaluate LongForcing on text-to-video generation and interactive action-conditioned world models, achieving a VBench Quality score of 85.52 and improving WorldRoamBench 60s action score by 23.9 points in first-person ablations. Qualitative stress tests further sample interactive rollouts up to 24 hours, far beyond the training horizon. These results suggest that scaling supervision along the temporal axis is a practical step toward long-horizon world models. The project website and code are at https://github.com/Fantasy-AMAP/LongForcing.

摘要（中文）：自回归视频扩散模型已成为长视野世界推演的基础架构。然而，当这些模型被扩展至远超其训练窗口的时长时，会出现渐进式漂移：视觉质量退化、运动变得不连贯、物体身份在生成帧被递归用作上下文的过程中逐渐崩塌。我们研究了监督视野差距：短视野蒸馏使得后续推演状态缺乏直接监督。我们证明，匹配短窗口边际分布并不必然决定长视野行为，而更长的在线策略轨迹则会延迟揭示训练中的失败。这促使我们在长视野世界模型中实施大规模时间流形匹配。基于这一洞察，我们提出了LongForcing，一种将教师监督扩展到学生长自推演过程的蒸馏方法。LongForcing保留了短视野教师强迫和因果常微分方程蒸馏阶段，同时在最终分布匹配阶段将实际分数教师替换为扩展视野的双向教师。该长视野教师利用标准分布匹配公式对学生扩展自推演过程进行监督，无需修改学生架构或增加推理成本。我们在文本到视频生成和交互式动作条件世界模型上评估了LongForcing，取得了85.52的VBench质量得分，并在第一人称消融实验中将WorldRoamBench 60秒动作得分提升了23.9分。定性压力测试进一步采样了长达24小时的交互式推演，远超训练视野。这些结果表明，沿时间轴扩展监督规模是迈向长视野世界模型的务实一步。项目网站和代码见https://github.com/Fantasy-AMAP/LongForcing。

Authors: Ziyu Zhu, Zhaoxu Sun, Fan Jiang, Mengchao Wang, Junfeng Ni, Ting-Bing Xu, Zhicheng Liu, Mu Xu

FlowSim: Rendering-Free Closed-Loop Simulation for Evaluating End-to-End Driving Systems AutonomousDriving

closed-loop simulation end-to-end driving latent prediction rendering-free autonomous driving evaluation

简要说明：FlowSim提出了一种无渲染的闭环仿真方法，直接预测端到端驾驶系统的潜在表示，免去图像空间渲染和重新编码，提升速度与效率，同时保持下游行为一致性。

TLDR: FlowSim proposes a rendering-free closed-loop simulation method that directly predicts latent representations for end-to-end driving evaluation, eliminating image-space rendering and re-encoding, and improving speed and efficiency while preserving downstream behavior.

Abstract: Closed-loop evaluation of end-to-end (E2E) driving systems typically relies on generating sensor observations and re-processing them through the perception encoder, introducing substantial computational cost and a sim2real gap between simulated and real sensor observations. In this paper, we ask a more fundamental question: is image-space simulation necessary for closed-loop evaluation of E2E driving systems? We propose FlowSim, a rendering-free simulation paradigm that predicts the internal latent representation directly from a previous latent and target-frame symbolic scene conditions. The predicted latent is then processed by the original frozen downstream modules, eliminating image rendering and perception re-encoding. Explicit cross-frame agent association improves latent transition prediction and rollout stability, while variable-horizon simulation enables long-horizon prediction from a common real anchor without accumulating intermediate rollout errors. Experiments on nuScenes and NavSim demonstrate that FlowSim preserves downstream behavior competitively with, and often exceeds image-space simulation in source-to-reference agreement across variable simulation horizons and both dense and sparse latent representations. By predicting the latent directly, both instantiations of FlowSim simulate each step in 0.04--0.06s, substantially faster than the image-space simulation methods they are compared against. These results establish FlowSim as an efficient and practical alternative to conventional image-space simulation methods.

摘要（中文）：闭环评估端到端（E2E）驾驶系统通常依赖于生成传感器观测数据，并通过感知编码器对其进行再处理，这带来了大量的计算开销，以及模拟与真实传感器观测之间的仿真到现实差距。本文提出了一个更为根本的问题：在端到端驾驶系统的闭环评估中，图像空间仿真是否必要？我们提出FlowSim，一种免渲染的仿真范式，直接从先前的潜在表示和目标帧符号化场景条件预测内部潜在表示。随后，预测得到的潜在表示由原始冻结的下游模块处理，从而消除了图像渲染和感知重编码。显式的跨帧代理关联提升了潜在状态转移预测和滚动稳定性，而可变时域仿真则能够在共享的真实锚点基础上进行长期预测，而无需累积中间滚动误差。在nuScenes和NavSim上的实验表明，FlowSim在下游行为上与图像空间仿真相当，且在源到参考的一致性方面，在多种仿真时域及稠密和稀疏潜在表示下通常优于图像空间仿真。通过直接预测潜在表示，FlowSim的两种实例在每一步仅需0.04至0.06秒完成仿真，远快于与其比较的图像空间仿真方法。这些结果确立了FlowSim作为传统图像空间仿真方法的一种高效且实用的替代方案。

Authors: Hanfeng Wu, Alvaro Marcos-Ramiro, Michael Schmidt, Christoph Stiller

EgoExplorer: A Vision-Motion-Touch Observatory for Human Loco-Manipulation In Situ HumanoidEmbodied

human loco-manipulation egocentric video whole-body motion reconstruction tactile sensing humanoid retargeting

简要说明：EgoExplorer 提出了一个100小时的可穿戴视觉-运动-触觉人体移动操作数据集，并开发了校准-完善-约束流程以重建全身运动、手指关节和触觉信号，支持多模态生成和仿真中的人形机器人重定向。

TLDR: EgoExplorer introduces a 100-hour wearable vision-motion-touch dataset of human loco-manipulation with a Calibrate-Complete-Constrain pipeline to reconstruct whole-body motion, finger articulation, and tactile signals, enabling multimodal generation and humanoid retargeting in simulation.

Abstract: Learning humanoid loco-manipulation from human demonstrations rests on observing how locomotion, posture, and object interaction evolve together as tasks unfold. Scaling collection across diverse environments, in turn, favors lightweight, portable capture systems. Yet, existing datasets provide only partial views of this coordination. Thus, we introduce EgoExplorer, a 100-hour vision-motion-touch observatory of human loco-manipulation built with a wearable system. With an emphasis on professional activities, its continuous recordings align egocentric video with reconstructed whole-body motion, fine-grained finger articulation, and tactile observations, accompanied by step-level descriptions. To achieve this coverage with sparse body sensing, we develop the Calibrate-Complete-Constrain pipeline. Concretely, reusable calibration fixes participant geometry and sensor attachments before motion inference to disentangle mounting offsets from articulation. A temporal prior then completes unobserved joint motion, while layered constraints promote measurement agreement, temporal continuity, and geometric consistency, properties that motion plausibility alone does not guarantee. Against tracker-fitted references, the method reduces body-point error by 71.9% relative to the strongest baseline; matched evaluations also show gains in hand stability and contact estimation. Preliminary studies explore multimodal generation and conditioning alongside humanoid retargeting with whole-body control in simulation.

摘要（中文）：从人类演示中学习人形机器人全身操控，其核心在于观察运动、姿态与物体交互在任务推进过程中如何协同演化。为在不同环境中大规模采集数据，轻量化、可穿戴的采集系统成为优选方案。然而，现有数据集仅能提供这种协同关系的局部视角。为此，我们提出EgoExplorer——一个基于可穿戴系统构建的、包含100小时视觉-运动-触觉观测数据的人形全身操控观测库。该数据集聚焦专业活动场景，其连续录制将第一人称视角视频与重建的全身运动、精细手指关节运动及触觉观测对齐，并配有步级描述。为在稀疏身体传感条件下实现上述覆盖，我们开发了“标定-补全-约束”流水线。具体而言，可复用的标定步骤在运动推断前固定受试者几何参数与传感器安装位置，从而将安装偏移与关节运动解耦；随后，时间先验用于补全未观测到的关节运动；分层约束则促进测量一致性、时间连续性与几何一致性——这些属性仅靠运动合理性无法保证。与基于追踪器拟合的参考数据相比，该方法将身体点误差相对于最强基线降低了71.9%；匹配评估还显示手部稳定性与接触估计均有提升。初步研究探索了多模态生成与条件控制，以及结合全身控制的人形机器人重定向仿真。

Authors: Yunsong Zhou, Xuekun Jiang, Haiqi Shen, Hangxu Liu, Chaojian Shi, Yujie Liu, Jingyuan Li, Haoran Yang, Jiafei Cao, Dongzhan Zhou, Dong Wang, Yao Mu, Chunhua Shen, Weinan Zhang

EmbodiedEvo: Self-Evolving Coding Agent For Physical Intelligence Manipulation

coding agent self-evolving physical feedback closed-loop policy RoboDojo-Sim

简要说明：EmbodiedEvo 提出了一种自进化编码智能体，将物理反馈提炼为可复用的技能和经验教训，无需微调即可实现闭环具身控制，并在 RoboDojo-Sim 上取得了领先成绩。

TLDR: EmbodiedEvo introduces a self-evolving coding agent that distills physical feedback into reusable Skills and Lessons, enabling closed-loop embodied control without fine-tuning and achieving state-of-the-art scores on RoboDojo-Sim.

Abstract: Coding agents can construct executable programs and revise them through feedback, offering a foundation for embodied control without target-task fine-tuning. Through a programmatic robot interface, the agent observes the scene, executes control programs, and adapts them to the resulting physical state, serving as the closed-loop policy. However, this within-episode adaptation does not automatically preserve experience across scenes. Our trajectory analysis shows that agents spend interaction and inference budgets establishing effective operations and identifying their preconditions, while fresh agents cannot reuse these discoveries. This motivates EmbodiedEvo, a self-evolving coding agent that distills physical feedback into reusable code Skills and diagnostic Lessons. Experience is acquired on one Playground scene per task, then frozen for independent agents in unseen scenes, without updating model weights. On RoboDojo-Sim, EmbodiedEvo achieves an average score of 44.48 and a success rate of 37.82\%, surpassing all officially verified results. Paired tests show the largest gains on memory-dependent tasks and successful reuse of coordinated procedures, while fine contact control remains difficult. Experience from stronger models also improves weaker executors: Astra's experience raises Sol and Luna's success rates by 8.86 and 5.50 percentage points over no experience. Compared with raw interaction history, Skills and Lessons achieve comparable task performance at 53.0\% lower execution cost.

摘要（中文）：编码智能体能够构建可执行程序，并通过反馈对其进行修正，从而无需针对目标任务进行微调即可实现具身控制的基础。通过程序化机器人接口，智能体观察场景、执行控制程序，并根据由此产生的物理状态对其进行调整，充当闭环策略。然而，这种回合内自适应并不能自动跨场景保留经验。我们的轨迹分析表明，智能体会耗费交互与推理预算来建立有效操作并识别其前置条件，而新启动的智能体无法复用这些发现。这促使我们提出EmbodiedEvo——一种自我进化的编码智能体，它将物理反馈提炼为可复用的代码技能（Skills）和诊断性经验（Lessons）。经验在每个任务的一个Playground场景中获取，随后被冻结，供未见场景中的独立智能体使用，而无需更新模型权重。在RoboDojo-Sim上，EmbodiedEvo取得了44.48的平均得分和37.82%的成功率，超越了所有官方验证结果。配对测试显示，在依赖记忆的任务上增益最大，协调程序得到了成功复用，而精细接触控制仍然困难。来自更强模型的经验也能提升较弱执行器的表现：Astra的经验使Sol和Luna的成功率分别比无经验时提升了8.86和5.50个百分点。与原始交互历史相比，技能与经验在任务性能相当的情况下，执行成本降低了53.0%。

Authors: Wenyi Li, Yizhe Chi, Youjie Zheng, Chunyu Liu, Xiaoqiu Wang, Mingju Gao, Zheng Jiang, Deyao Hong, Calvin Xiao, Kaisen Yang, Qinhuai Na

Who Improves the Robot? Toward Physical Recursive Self-Improvement RLRobot

Physical Recursive Self-Improvement robot learning self-improvement safety L0-L5 framework

简要说明：本文提出了物理递归自我改进（Physical RSI）的L0-L5框架，其中机器人利用物理经验来改进其能力和改进流程。文章综述了现有方法并指出了研究空白，结论是当前没有方法完全实现Physical RSI。

TLDR: This paper introduces a framework (L0-L5) for Physical Recursive Self-Improvement (Physical RSI), where robots use physical experience to improve both their capabilities and their improvement procedures. It surveys existing methods and identifies research gaps, concluding that no current method fully achieves Physical RSI.

Abstract: Robots are increasingly autonomous in task execution, yet their improvement remains largely human-driven. This study investigates Physical Recursive Self-Improvement (Physical RSI), in which physical experience guides lasting updates to both a robot's capabilities and its improvement procedure, making subsequent improvement more effective across tasks. Physical RSI faces challenges from noisy observations, continuous dynamics, costly trials, and irreversible consequences. We present an L0-L5 framework that differentiates capability-level from meta-level updates and within-task from across-task gains, reserving L5 for independently verified recursive gain. We study existing methods around harness adaptation and model training, alongside safety and control mechanisms that govern execution and successive updates. Our analysis reveals that, despite substantial progress in self-improvement, the surveyed literature does not yet demonstrate Physical RSI as defined by our framework. We identify research priorities in reliable feedback, causal attribution, safety preservation, and benchmarking, outlining a path toward robots that autonomously improve how they learn while ensuring safety. The GitHub repository for Physical RSI is available at https://github.com/SAIL-Research-Lab/Physical-RSI.

摘要（中文）：机器人执行任务的自主性日益增强，但其改进仍主要依赖人类驱动。本研究探讨了物理递归自我改进（Physical RSI），即通过物理经验引导机器人能力及其改进程序的持久更新，从而使后续改进在不同任务中更加有效。物理RSI面临噪声观测、连续动力学、高代价试验及不可逆后果等挑战。我们提出了一个L0-L5框架，用以区分能力层与元层的更新，以及任务内与跨任务的收益，其中L5专指经独立验证的递归收益。我们考察了现有方法，涵盖自适应机制调整与模型训练，以及控制执行和连续更新的安全与控制机制。分析表明，尽管自我改进已取得显著进展，但所调查的文献尚未展示符合我们框架定义的物理RSI。我们确定了可靠反馈、因果归因、安全保障和基准测试方面的研究重点，勾勒出一条使机器人能够自主改进学习方式并同时确保安全性的路径。物理RSI的GitHub代码库可在 https://github.com/SAIL-Research-Lab/Physical-RSI 获取。

Authors: Hai Zhou, Fan Yang, Zeyi Chen, Lejun Zhang, Chenyang Fu, Jianping Li, Jiayi Zhu, Xianyang Liu, Yingxuan Yang, Lili Meng, Lu Wang, Xinyang Han, Jiankai Sun, Weirui Ye, Guanchu Wang, Wanhua Li, Ming Zhou, Boyi Li, Ming Jin, Kun Shao, Muhao Chen, Guang Chen, Lei Ma, Joey Tianyi Zhou, Costas Spanos, Xia Hu, Mac Schwager, Weinan Zhang, Qian Feng, Shangding Gu

RoboSimStudio: An Interactive Toolkit for Human and Agent Rapid Real2Sim of Robot Manipulation Tasks Manipulation

real2sim robot manipulation physics simulation contact model agentic

简要说明：RoboSimStudio 是一个交互式工具包，通过使物理求解器和接触模型的选择显式且可编辑，帮助人类和编码代理快速创建并迭代优化机器人操作任务的真实到仿真模拟。

TLDR: RoboSimStudio is an interactive toolkit that enables humans and coding agents to rapidly create and refine real2sim simulations of robot manipulation tasks by making physics solver and contact model choices explicit and editable.

Abstract: It has been difficult to accurately model the physics of the interaction between a robot and the objects it manipulates, including contact mechanics, coupled contact dynamics, deformations, stiffness and friction. We present RoboSimStudio (RSS), an interactive toolkit that makes choices of solver, contact model, and physical parameters explicit and editable, allowing both humans and coding agents to quickly create and iteratively refine simulations based on observed physical behavior. We implement RSS with the open Newton physics simulation system and describe experiments with human-guided real2sim using (1) visual evaluation, (2) force-feedback and (3) agentic Real2Sim2Real. Code, video and additional information can be found on the project website: https://robosimstudio.github.io

摘要（中文）：对机器人与其所操控物体之间相互作用的物理过程进行精确建模一直颇具挑战，这涉及接触力学、耦合接触动力学、变形、刚度及摩擦等方面。我们提出了RoboSimStudio（RSS），一个交互式工具包，它将求解器、接触模型和物理参数的选择明确化并可编辑，使人类用户和编码智能体都能基于观察到的物理行为快速创建并迭代优化仿真。我们利用开源的Newton物理仿真系统实现了RSS，并描述了在人类引导下的real2sim实验，涵盖（1）视觉评估、（2）力反馈和（3）智能体驱动的Real2Sim2Real。代码、视频及更多信息可在项目网站获取：https://robosimstudio.github.io

Authors: Kaiyuan Chen, Shuangyu Xie, Uksang Yoo, Xinyue Zhu, Cael Magner, Alvin Zhu, Daehwa Kim, Eric Heiden, Erwin Coumans, Miles Macklin, Spencer Huang, Ken Goldberg

RoboFQE: Rollout-Free Evaluation of Visual Robot Policies from Offline Trajectories Manipulation

off-policy evaluation fitted Q-evaluation vision foundation model terminal success annotation manipulation

简要说明：RoboFQE提出了一种无部署的视觉机器人策略评估方法，利用离线轨迹、拟合Q评估、预训练视觉基础模型和学习到的终端成功标注来估计折扣回报，避免了模拟器或世界模型的预测误差。

TLDR: RoboFQE introduces a rollout-free evaluator for visual robot policies that estimates discounted returns from offline trajectories using fitted Q-evaluation, a pretrained vision foundation model, and learned terminal success annotation, avoiding simulator/world-model prediction errors.

Abstract: Evaluating robot policies before deployment typically requires producing new trajectories through real-world execution, simulators, or learned world models. These rollout-based approaches impose infrastructure requirements; simulator and world-model evaluators additionally face prediction errors that can compound over the evaluation horizon. In this paper, we study off-policy evaluation as an alternative to rollout-based robot-policy evaluation methods. Specifically, we introduce RoboFQE, an evaluator that estimates the discounted expected return of a target policy from offline robot trajectories without estimating a behavior-policy density, combining fitted Q-evaluation with a pretrained vision foundation model and learned terminal success annotation to bridge the gap between standard OPE benchmarks and continuous-control visual manipulation. Controlled experiments across simulated and real-world manipulation tasks show that RoboFQE produces accurate discounted-return estimates and preserves policy rankings even on long-horizon manipulation tasks where video world-model evaluators are degraded by autoregressive prediction errors. Ablation experiments show that pretrained vision encoders substantially outperform from-scratch alternatives, particularly on long-horizon tasks, and that learned terminal success annotation enables evaluation without ground-truth reward labels with only slight reduction of accuracy.

摘要（中文）：在部署机器人策略之前进行评估，通常需要借助真实环境执行、仿真器或学习得到的世界模型来生成新的轨迹。这类基于轨迹展开的方法对基础设施提出了较高要求；同时，仿真器和世界模型评估器还面临预测误差在评估时间跨度内累积放大的问题。在本文中，我们研究将离线策略评估作为基于轨迹展开的机器人策略评估方法的一种替代方案。具体而言，我们提出了RoboFQE评估器，它能够从离线机器人轨迹中估计目标策略的折扣期望回报，且无需估计行为策略的密度。该方法将拟合Q评估与预训练的视觉基础模型以及学习得到的终端成功标注相结合，以弥合标准离线策略评估基准与连续控制视觉操作任务之间的差距。在仿真和真实世界操作任务的受控实验中，RoboFQE表现出能够生成准确的折扣回报估计，并在长时程操作任务中保持策略排序，而视频世界模型评估器在此类任务中则会因自回归预测误差而性能下降。消融实验表明，预训练的视觉编码器在性能上显著优于从零训练的替代方案，尤其是在长时程任务中；同时，学习得到的终端成功标注能够在无真实奖励标签的情况下进行评估，且仅带来轻微的精度损失。

Authors: Yunfu Deng, Sangwoo Shin, Brahma S. Pavse, Josiah P. Hanna

Model-Based Online Decision Making via Generative Trajectory Planning Manipulation

generative trajectory planning diffusion prior model-based decision-making long-horizon manipulation continuous control

简要说明：GTP 提出了一种基于模型的框架，将生成模型视为动作序列的提议分布，通过使用学习到的动态、奖励和价值模型对候选序列进行采样和优化，实现高效的轨迹级规划，并在连续控制和长期操作任务中表现出色。

TLDR: GTP proposes a model-based framework that treats a generative model as a proposal distribution for action sequences, enabling efficient trajectory-level planning by sampling and refining candidates with learned dynamics, reward, and value models, and demonstrates strong performance in continuous control and long-horizon manipulation.

Abstract: Online decision-making faces a tension between efficient inference and long-horizon reasoning. Value-based methods rely on short-horizon bootstrapping that limits the propagation of long-term information, while trajectory optimization methods plan explicitly but must solve a high-dimensional optimization problem at every decision step. We propose Generative Trajectory Planning (GTP), a model-based framework that addresses this tension by learning a generative model as a proposal distribution over action sequences. Instead of optimizing sequences from scratch, GTP samples candidate sequences from a diffusion prior and refines them using learned dynamics, reward, and value models, enabling efficient trajectory-level reasoning. Across continuous control and long-horizon manipulation tasks, GTP matches or exceeds state-of-the-art model-free, diffusion-policy, and model-based baselines, and remains stable in regimes where strong baselines degrade. Our results suggest that generative models are best understood not as policies, but as structured proposal distributions for planning, offering a new perspective on how to integrate generative modeling with model-based decision-making.

摘要（中文）：在线决策面临着高效推理与长时程推理之间的矛盾。基于价值的方法依赖短时程自举，限制了长期信息的传播，而轨迹优化方法虽显式规划，却需在每个决策步骤求解高维优化问题。我们提出了生成式轨迹规划（GTP），一种基于模型的框架，通过学习一个生成模型作为动作序列上的提议分布来解决这一矛盾。GTP并非从零开始优化序列，而是从扩散先验中采样候选序列，并利用学习得到的动力学、奖励和价值模型对其进行优化，从而实现高效的轨迹级推理。在连续控制和长时程操作任务中，GTP匹配或超越了最先进的无模型、扩散策略和基于模型的基线方法，并在强基线方法性能下降的领域中保持稳定。我们的结果表明，生成模型的最佳理解方式并非作为策略，而是作为用于规划的结构化提议分布，这为将生成建模与基于模型的决策相结合提供了新的视角。

Authors: Haldun Balim, Yilun Du, Na Li

Perception Beyond the Visible: Incompleteness-Aware Scene Understanding for Robot Autonomy Perception3D

amodal perception semantic occupancy forecasting open-world scene understanding uncertainty-guided multi-modal fusion belief-centric 4D scene representations

简要说明：本文提出了一个面向机器人自主性的不完整性感知场景理解研究愿景，通过非模态感知、语义占用预测和不确定性引导融合来解决遮挡、新物体和传感器退化问题，并展望了信念中心4D表示的未来方向。

TLDR: The paper presents a research vision for incompleteness-aware scene understanding in robot autonomy, addressing occlusions, novel objects, and sensor degradation through amodal perception, semantic occupancy forecasting, and uncertainty-guided fusion, with future directions toward belief-centric 4D representations.

Abstract: Reliable robot autonomy requires reasoning about the world from partial and noisy observations. However, many perception systems model only visible scene regions, rely on fixed semantic categories, and assume reliable sensor measurements. These assumptions break under occlusion, novel object encounters, and sensor degradation. In this paper, I present a research vision for incompleteness-aware scene understanding. I organize this vision around three fundamental challenges: incomplete evidence, incomplete knowledge, and incomplete sensor reliability. I discuss my research contributions toward addressing these challenges through amodal perception, semantic occupancy forecasting, open-world scene understanding, label-efficient learning, and uncertainty-guided multi-modal fusion. Building on these contributions, I outline future research directions toward belief-centric 4D scene representations. These representations aim to jointly model geometry, semantics, motion, and uncertainty. I also discuss active sensing and safe adaptation strategies that allow robots to reduce uncertainty through interaction. The goal is to develop calibrated and actionable scene representations that support reliable autonomy in dynamic, open-world environments.

摘要（中文）：可靠的机器人自主性要求从部分且有噪声的观测中推理世界状态。然而，许多感知系统仅建模可见场景区域，依赖固定的语义类别，并假设传感器测量可靠。这些假设在遮挡、遇到新颖物体及传感器退化的情况下均会失效。本文提出了一种面向不完整性感知的场景理解研究愿景。我围绕三个基本挑战组织这一愿景：证据不完整、知识不完整以及传感器可靠性不完整。我探讨了通过非模态感知、语义占用预测、开放世界场景理解、标签高效学习及不确定性引导的多模态融合来应对这些挑战的研究贡献。基于这些贡献，我概述了面向以信念为中心的4D场景表示的未来研究方向。这些表示旨在联合建模几何、语义、运动及不确定性。我还讨论了主动感知和安全适应策略，使机器人能够通过交互降低不确定性。目标在于开发经过校准且可操作性的场景表示，以支持动态开放世界环境中的可靠自主性。

Authors: Rohit Mohan

CALM: Decentralized Control of Cooperative Aerial Manipulation with Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning Manipulation

multi-agent reinforcement learning aerial manipulation decentralized control UAV MAPPO

简要说明：CALM提出了一种用于协作空中操纵的去中心化多智能体强化学习控制器，通过共享参数、目标估计、扩展状态观测器和预期编队偏航前馈，提高了对移动地面机器人的跟踪性能。

TLDR: CALM presents a decentralized multi-agent reinforcement learning controller for cooperative aerial manipulation, using shared parameters, goal estimation, extended state observers, and anticipatory formation-yaw feedforward to improve tracking of a moving ground robot with a basket.

Abstract: Cooperative aerial manipulation is difficult under wind, payload motion, and noisy goal broadcasts because multiple Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) are coupled through a shared payload. We present CALM (Cooperative Aerial Learned Manipulation), a decentralized controller for aerial manipulators carrying a basket while tracking a moving ground robot. CALM combines a parameter-shared Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL) policy, trained using Multi-Agent Proximal Policy Optimization (MAPPO), with goal estimation, per-UAV Extended State Observers (ESOs), basket-mass estimation, and anticipatory formation-yaw feedforward. The anticipatory formation-yaw feedforward uses estimated goal motion to rotate the formation before position error develops, reducing basket-yaw lag without adding net commanded force. A disturbance-conditioned critic supports centralized training while execution remains decentralized. Across held-out trajectories, CALM achieves lower mean position and orientation errors than all evaluated baselines, including the matched arm baseline (7.68 versus 10.95 cm and 3.3 versus 4.7$^\circ$), the cable-suspended realization, and two model-based controllers. Under unseen full-information-path degradation, CALM remains statistically comparable or superior to the arm baseline. Videos are available at https://petreric.github.io/CALM/.

摘要（中文）：协作式空中操控在风力、负载运动以及噪声目标广播条件下具有较大难度，因为多架无人机通过共享负载相互耦合。本文提出了CALM（协作式空中学习操控），这是一种用于空中操控器的分散式控制器，能够携带吊篮并跟踪移动的地面机器人。CALM将基于多智能体近端策略优化（MAPPO）训练的共享参数多智能体强化学习策略，与目标估计、每架无人机扩展状态观测器、吊篮质量估计以及预测性编队偏航前馈相结合。预测性编队偏航前馈利用估计的目标运动，在位置误差产生之前旋转编队，从而在不增加净指令力的情况下减少吊篮偏航滞后。扰动条件评价器支持集中式训练，而执行过程保持分散。在保留轨迹上，CALM的平均位置和姿态误差均低于所有评估基线，包括匹配机械臂基线（7.68厘米对比10.95厘米，3.3°对比4.7°）、缆绳悬挂方案以及两种基于模型的控制方法。在未知的全信息路径退化情形下，CALM在统计上依然与机械臂基线相当或更优。视频见https://petreric.github.io/CALM/。

Authors: Jiaxi Huo, Petre Ricioppo, Fausto Francesco Lizzio

I2O2I-Nav: A Benchmark with a Modular Agent for Long-Horizon Indoor-to-Outdoor-to-Indoor Navigation VLN

long-horizon navigation indoor-to-outdoor navigation modular agent benchmark stage composition

简要说明：I2O2I-Nav 提出了一个物理启用的基准测试和一个模块化智能体，用于长时程室内到室外再到室内导航，在20个真实场景和1374个回合中评估组合导航能力，表明模块化协调相比固定策略链提升了成功率，但完整任务成功率仍然较低。

TLDR: I2O2I-Nav introduces a physics-enabled benchmark and a modular agent for long-horizon indoor-to-outdoor-to-indoor navigation, evaluating composed navigation capabilities across 20 real-world scenes and 1,374 episodes, showing that modular coordination improves success over fixed policy chains though full mission success remains challenging.

Abstract: Service and delivery robots often need to complete long-horizon navigation missions spanning indoor and outdoor environments. Existing embodied navigation benchmarks primarily evaluate isolated stages or partial cross-domain journeys, providing limited support for assessing how heterogeneous navigation capabilities compose under continuous execution. We introduce I2O2I-Nav, a physics-enabled benchmark of 20 real-world composite scenes spanning over 115,000 square meters across multiple buildings and floors, with aligned 3DGS rendering and collision geometry. Its three-level evaluation progresses from independent primitives to two-stage compositions and complete four-stage I2O2I missions. Each stage starts from its predecessor's actual endpoint, while stage-conditional metrics track completion and localize failures along the mission. We further propose the MODULAR-Agent that coordinates frozen navigation policies through completion verification, stage handoffs, and bounded recovery. Evaluation across 1,374 episodes highlights the difficulty of continuous composition. The MODULAR-Agent achieves 40.5-76% success on individual primitives, but full I2O2I success remains low. Compared with a fixed policy chain using the same underlying policies, it more than doubles success on both Indoor-to-Outdoor (I2O) and Outdoor-to-Indoor (O2I), while improving full-mission success from 1.15% to 4.02%. Stage-wise analysis shows that the MODULAR-Agent enables more missions to reach the final object-navigation stage, where conditional success remains low, revealing challenges in both long-horizon stage execution and completion decisions.

摘要（中文）：服务与配送机器人通常需要完成跨越室内外环境的长时间导航任务。现有具身导航基准主要评估独立阶段或部分跨域行程，难以全面支持异构导航能力在连续执行中的组合评估。为此，我们提出I2O2I-Nav，一个基于物理引擎的基准，涵盖20个真实世界复合场景，总面积超过115,000平方米，跨越多个建筑和楼层，并配有对齐的3DGS渲染与碰撞几何。其三级评估体系从独立基本技能逐步推进至两阶段组合任务，最终覆盖完整的四阶段I2O2I任务。每个阶段均从前一阶段的实际终点出发，阶段条件指标用于追踪完成情况并定位任务中的失败点。我们进一步提出MODULAR-Agent，通过完成验证、阶段交接和受限恢复机制协调冻结的导航策略。在1,374个回合上的评估凸显了连续组合的难度。MODULAR-Agent在单项基本技能上的成功率为40.5%-76%，但完整的I2O2I任务成功率仍然较低。与使用相同底层策略的固定策略链相比，MODULAR-Agent在室内到室外（I2O）和室外到室内（O2I）两个阶段上的成功率均提升了一倍以上，并将完整任务成功率从1.15%提升至4.02%。分阶段分析显示，MODULAR-Agent使更多任务能够到达最终的目标物体导航阶段，但该阶段的条件成功率依然偏低，揭示了长时间阶段执行与完成决策方面的双重挑战。

Authors: Zhengjie Shu, Wanyu Li, Di Xiao, Lingxin Jiang, Lai Jiang, Kaidi Hu, Xincheng Tang, Wenkang Hu, Haoran Wang, Jinchuan Zhang, Chang Chen, Wei Li, Jia Pan, Ruigang Yang

Cross-Embodiment Affordance Transfer for Robotic Manipulation Manipulation

affordance transfer robot-executable affordance cross-embodiment point cloud manipulation

简要说明：该论文提出一个框架，将人类标注的物体可供性转换为基于机器人几何和约束的可执行可供性预测，通过解决人类与机器人可供性不匹配的问题来改进操作规划。

TLDR: This paper proposes a framework that translates human-annotated object affordances into robot-executable affordance predictions conditioned on robot geometry and constraints, improving manipulation planning by addressing the mismatch between human and robot affordances.

Abstract: Robotic manipulation systems commonly learn object affordances from human-annotated datasets, which reflect interaction possibilities for a human hand rather than the physical constraints of a specific robot. For example, a surface region of an object identified as graspable by a human annotator may be geometrically unreachable or mechanically infeasible for a robot, yet this mismatch is rarely addressed explicitly. To tackle this challenge, we proposed a framework that translates human affordance annotations into robot-executable affordance predictions conditioned on the physical properties of the robot. The network predicts which surface regions of an object are physically executable by the robot, given a 3D point cloud of an object and a descriptor encoding the robot's geometry and constraints. The model was trained using human-annotated affordances together with robotic execution outcomes from multiple sampled approach trials in simulation, where execution outcomes determined which regions are executable for the robot. The evaluation was performed on a household objects dataset using two parallel-jaw gripper configurations on a UR5e robot arm. The framework outperformed a model that does not receive information about the robot. The experimental results demonstrated that affordance prediction must be conditioned on the robot and that human annotations alone are insufficient for learning robot-executable affordance representations.

摘要（中文）：机器人操控系统通常从人工标注的数据集中学习物体可供性，这些数据集反映的是人类手部的交互可能性，而非特定机器人的物理约束。例如，人类标注者认为可抓取的物体表面区域，对于机器人而言可能在几何上不可达或机械上不可行，然而这种不匹配却很少被明确处理。为解决这一挑战，我们提出了一个框架，将人类可供性标注转化为以机器人物理属性为条件的机器人可执行可供性预测。该网络基于物体的三维点云和编码机器人几何形状及约束条件的描述符，预测物体表面哪些区域对机器人而言物理可执行。模型使用人工标注的可供性信息以及仿真中多次采样尝试的机器人执行结果进行训练，其中执行结果决定了哪些区域对机器人可执行。评估在家庭物体数据集上进行，使用了UR5e机械臂上的两种平行夹爪配置。该框架优于未接收机器人信息的模型。实验结果表明，可供性预测必须以机器人为条件，仅靠人工标注不足以学习机器人可执行的可供性表征。

Authors: Sawera Yaseen, Serge Thill, Rekha Raja

Assessing the Quality of Concrete Scenarios Generated from Scenario Classes for Automated Driving AutonomousDriving

scenario-based testing diversity quality functions automated driving verification scenario sampling virtual toolchain

简要说明：本文提出了通过聚合场景距离度量来量化自动驾驶具体场景集合多样性的质量函数，并在虚拟验证工具链中进行了实验验证。

TLDR: This paper introduces quality functions that aggregate scenario distance measures to quantify the diversity of concrete scenario collections for automated driving, with proofs and experiments in a virtual verification toolchain.

Abstract: A scenario-based development approach has become state of the art for automated driving systems. Once a set of scenario classes covering the operational design domain is available, concrete scenarios are generated from these scenario classes, e.g., to be used for hazard analysis and risk assessment or for the system's verification and validation. For such applications, a high diversity among the generated concrete scenarios is paramount. The question arises how the quality of collections of concrete scenarios can be assessed in such a setting. In this work, we aggregate scenario distance measures into so-called quality functions that quantify the diversity of concrete scenario collections in the context of automated driving. In particular, we consider the case where scenario classes are formalized as constraint systems and the associated concrete scenario space is not explicitly known. Based on a set of desired properties we construct candidates for such quality functions and give proofs for their property fulfillment. To show the practical relevance of quality functions, we perform a variety of experiments in the context of an abstract scenario-based virtual verification toolchain for automated driving systems. More specifically, we use quality functions to compare the effectiveness of variation methods for sampling, examine the choice of different scenario distance measures, and investigate the effects of temporal aspects on concrete scenario collection quality.

摘要（中文）：基于场景的开发方法已成为自动驾驶系统的最新发展水平。一旦获得覆盖操作设计域的一组场景类别，便从这些场景类别中生成具体场景，例如用于危害分析与风险评估，或用于系统的验证与确认。在此类应用中，所生成具体场景之间的高度多样性至关重要。由此引发的问题是如何在这种背景下评估具体场景集合的质量。在本研究中，我们将场景距离度量聚合为所谓的质量函数，用以量化自动驾驶背景下具体场景集合的多样性。特别地，我们考虑了场景类别被形式化为约束系统且相关具体场景空间并非显式已知的情况。基于一组期望属性，我们构建了此类质量函数的候选形式，并对其属性满足性给出了证明。为展示质量函数的实际应用价值，我们在自动驾驶系统抽象场景基虚拟验证工具链的背景下进行了多种实验。具体而言，我们利用质量函数比较不同采样变异方法的有效性，考察不同场景距离度量的选择，并研究时间因素对具体场景集合质量的影响。

Authors: Lina Putze, Thies de Graaff, Jan Steffen Becker, Christian Neurohr

RESTA: Time-Scaling Augmentation for Data-Efficient Robot Imitation Learning Manipulation

data augmentation imitation learning trajectory reversal temporal resampling bimanual manipulation

简要说明：本文提出RESTA，一种结合轨迹反转和时间步长重采样的时间缩放数据增强方法，以提高机器人模仿学习的数据效率，在仅用一半示范数据的情况下达到与基线相当的性能。

TLDR: This paper proposes RESTA, a time-scaling data augmentation method combining trajectory reversal and temporal stride resampling to improve data efficiency in robot imitation learning, achieving performance comparable to baselines trained with twice the demonstrations.

Abstract: Robot manipulation policies trained through imitation learning commonly rely on costly demonstrations recorded in one task direction and at one temporal resolution. We propose Reversal and Stride-based Trajectory Augmentation (RESTA), which exploits time-scaling data augmentation to improve data efficiency through trajectory reversal and temporal resampling. Trajectory-reversal augmentation reverses and relabels demonstrations between paired tasks with opposite objectives, reusing recorded rollouts without additional environment interaction. Because contact-rich manipulation is not exactly reversible, we treat reversal as an approximate paired-task prior rather than a physical symmetry. Temporal-stride augmentation varies observation and action sampling strides and conditions the policy on the resulting offsets, enabling fixed or randomized temporal schedules. Experiments across 16 paired bimanual manipulation tasks show that trajectory reversal is particularly effective in the low-data regime and that temporal-stride augmentation improves success under randomized temporal schedules. With 25 and 50 independently collected demonstrations per task, RESTA achieves 78.4% and 85.2% average success, respectively, matching or exceeding baselines trained with twice as many demonstrations (77.3% and 85.4%). These results show that RESTA can improve data efficiency in robot imitation learning.

摘要（中文）：通过模仿学习训练的机器人操控策略通常依赖于在单一任务方向和单一时间分辨率下记录的昂贵演示数据。我们提出了一种基于反转与步长的时间轨迹增强方法（RESTA），利用时间缩放数据增强，通过轨迹反转和时间重采样来提高数据效率。轨迹反转增强在具有相反目标的任务对之间反转并重新标记演示，无需额外的环境交互即可复用已记录的轨迹。由于接触丰富的操控并非严格可逆，我们将反转视为一种近似的配对任务先验，而非物理对称性。时间步长增强通过改变观测和动作的采样步长，并基于由此产生的偏移量对策略进行条件化，从而实现固定或随机的时序调度。在16个配对的双臂操控任务上的实验表明，轨迹反转在低数据场景下尤为有效，而时间步长增强在随机时序调度下能提升成功率。在每项任务仅使用25条和50条独立采集的演示数据时，RESTA分别达到了78.4%和85.2%的平均成功率，匹配或超过了使用两倍演示数据训练的基线方法（分别为77.3%和85.4%）。这些结果表明，RESTA能够有效提升机器人模仿学习中的数据效率。

Authors: Yunpeng Jiang, Jianshu Hu, Han Fang, Zhiyuan Guan, Paul Weng, Yutong Ban

MARTS: A Modular Agricultural Robot for Targeted Spraying of Diseased Tomato Plants in Greenhouses Manipulation

targeted spraying agricultural robot VLM-based detection mobile manipulation greenhouse deployment

简要说明：MARTS将Clearpath Husky和UR5与低成本喷洒末端执行器及基于VLM的检测管道集成，在商业温室中对患病番茄植株进行叶片级精准喷洒，实现了高命中率和71%的农药减量。

TLDR: MARTS integrates a Clearpath Husky and UR5 with a low-cost spraying end-effector and a VLM-based detection pipeline to perform leaf-localized targeted spraying of diseased tomato plants in commercial greenhouses, achieving high targeting accuracy and a 71% reduction in pesticide volume.

Abstract: Broadcast spraying remains the dominant method of disease control in greenhouse tomato production, yet it treats healthy and diseased tissue alike, exposes workers to hazardous aerosols, and depends on operator skill. This paper presents MARTS (Modular Agricultural Robot for Targeted Spraying), a low-cost robotic platform that closes the loop from plant-level disease detection to leaf-localised spray delivery in commercial greenhouses. MARTS integrates a Clearpath Husky A200 mobile base, a UR5 manipulator, a novel modular spraying end-effector built around a single 12 V micro-diaphragm pump, and a wrist-mounted Intel RealSense D435 RGB-D camera. Disease detection reuses our previously published Tomato Leaf Disease Vision Language Model (TLDVLM; Grounding DINO, SAM-2 and LoRA-tuned BLIP-2, 97.27% accuracy over 10 classes); this work focuses on actuation, control and system integration. A ROS pipeline lifts detections into 3D targets, generates collision-aware nozzle poses at a 120 mm stand-off using fitted leaf normals, and scales pump pulse duration to lesion area. Water-sensitive paper calibration showed a linear pulse-volume relationship (R^2 = 0.994). In MuJoCo simulation, an adaptive base-repositioning strategy achieved 100% coverage of 18 waypoints with a maximum orientation error of 1.1 deg. Deployed at the SILAL commercial greenhouse (Al Ain, UAE) on cherry tomatoes under natural infection, MARTS treated 312 diseased leaves in 12 autonomous trials with 92.4% targeting success, 18.7 mm mean spray-centre error, 6.1% adjacent-leaf overspray, and a 71% reduction in pesticide volume versus broadcast spraying. Mean cycle time was 4.8 s per leaf, and the spraying subsystem costs USD 412, 6-10x lower than comparable systems, showing that accurate leaf-level targeting is achievable on commodity hardware.

摘要（中文）：在温室番茄生产中，广谱喷施仍是病害防治的主导方式，但该方法对健康与染病组织一视同仁，使作业人员暴露于有害气溶胶中，且效果高度依赖操作者技能。本文提出MARTS（模块化精准喷施农业机器人）——一种低成本机器人平台，可在商业温室中实现从植株级病害检测到叶片局部喷施输送的闭环作业。MARTS集成Clearpath Husky A200移动底盘、UR5机械臂、基于单个12 V微型隔膜泵的新型模块化喷施末端执行器，以及腕部安装的Intel RealSense D435 RGB-D相机。病害检测复用本团队此前发表的番茄叶部病害视觉语言模型（TLDVLM；采用Grounding DINO、SAM-2及LoRA微调BLIP-2，10类病害分类精度达97.27%）；本研究重点聚焦于执行机构、控制与系统集成。ROS管线将检测结果映射至三维目标，利用拟合叶片法向量在120 mm工作距离处生成碰撞感知的喷嘴位姿，并根据病斑面积调节泵脉冲持续时间。水敏纸标定结果表明脉冲-喷量呈线性关系（R² = 0.994）。在MuJoCo仿真中，自适应底盘重定位策略实现了18个路径点的100%覆盖率，最大方位角误差为1.1°。在阿联酋艾因市SILAL商业温室的自然感病樱桃番茄上部署试验中，MARTS在12次自主试验中处理了312片染病叶片，靶向成功率为92.4%，平均喷施中心误差为18.7 mm，相邻叶片过喷率为6.1%，农药用量较广谱喷施减少71%。单叶平均作业周期为4.8 s，喷施子系统成本为412美元，较同类系统低6–10倍，证明在通用硬件上即可实现精准的叶片级靶向喷施。

Authors: Rajmeet Singh, Manveen Kaur, Yusuf Adamu, Lochan Kshetrimayum, Irfan Hussain

Breaking the Average: Overcoming Convergent Defaults in Robotic Manipulation via Diagnostic Chain-of-Thought and Structured Guidance VLA

Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models distributional convergence convergent defaults Chain-of-Thought prompting Lens Prompts

简要说明：该论文提出一个无需训练更新的框架，通过探测模式崩溃、利用潜在推理进行根因分析和注入结构化的“透镜提示”来识别并纠正VLA策略中的“收敛默认行为”，并在ManiSkill3模拟环境中使用π0.5进行验证。

TLDR: The paper proposes a training-free framework to identify and correct 'convergent defaults' in VLA policies by probing for mode collapse, using latent reasoning for root cause analysis, and injecting structured 'Lens Prompts' to shift the sampling distribution, validated in ManiSkill3 simulations with π0.5.

Abstract: Recent Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, such as $π_{0.5}$, have demonstrated impressive generalization capabilities by scaling behavior cloning across massive datasets. However, these models frequently suffer from distributional convergence, a phenomenon where the policy regresses to "safe" but suboptimal mean behaviors due to mode averaging in the training data. This often results in generic grasp strategies, Convergent Defaults, that fail in constrained or long-tail scenarios. In this work, we propose a novel framework to identify and correct these behaviors without parameter updates. We introduce a three-stage methodology: (1) Probing for Defaults, identifying task-specific mode collapse; (2) Diagnostic Root Cause Analysis, utilizing the VLA's latent reasoning capabilities to verbalize the logic behind suboptimal actions; and (3) Structured Guidance Injection, where concrete, distinct alternatives are encoded into reusable "Lens Prompts" that shift the sampling distribution. We validate this approach using $π_{0.5}$ in ManiSkill3 simulation environments. We hypothesize that our method outperforms vanilla $π_{0.5}$ and standard Chain-of-Thought prompting by effectively breaking convergent defaults in complex manipulation tasks.

摘要（中文）：近期开发的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型，如 \(π_{0.5}\)，通过在大规模数据集上进行行为克隆的扩展，展现出令人瞩目的泛化能力。然而，这些模型常常受到分布收敛问题的影响，即由于训练数据中的模态平均，策略会回归到“安全”但次优的平均行为。这一现象往往导致通用抓取策略——即“趋同默认”——在受限或长尾场景中失效。在本研究中，我们提出一种新颖的框架，在不更新参数的情况下识别并纠正这些行为。我们引入三阶段方法论：（1）默认行为探测，识别任务特定的模态崩溃；（2）诊断性根因分析，利用VLA模型的潜在推理能力，将次优行为背后的逻辑进行语言化表达；（3）结构化引导注入，将具体且截然不同的替代方案编码为可重用的“镜头提示”，以改变采样分布。我们使用 \(π_{0.5}\) 在ManiSkill3仿真环境中验证了该方法。我们假设，该方法能够有效打破复杂操作任务中的趋同默认，其性能优于原始 \(π_{0.5}\) 和标准链式思维提示方法。

Authors: Mohammed Daba, Waleed Abdulrahman Saleh AlAkwa

Locomotion with Online Awareness of Dynamics for Precision Footholds Locomotion

perceptive locomotion inertial estimation recurrent modules narrow-beam traversal unknown payload

简要说明：本文提出LOAD，一种感知运动框架，结合显式惯性估计和循环模块的隐式动力学特征，以提高未知载荷下窄梁穿越的成功率，并在仿真和硬件上验证。

TLDR: This paper presents LOAD, a perceptive locomotion framework that combines explicit inertial estimates with implicit dynamics features from recurrent modules to improve narrow-beam traversal under unknown payloads, validated in simulation and on hardware.

Abstract: Unknown payloads alter robot dynamics and make precise contact execution difficult when foothold margins are small. We present LOAD, a perceptive locomotion framework that combines explicit inertial estimates with implicit dynamics features for narrow-beam traversal. Separate recurrent modules infer torso inertial changes and task-relevant history from proprioception, while a height-map teacher is distilled into a depth-based student. We extensively evaluate LOAD and its variants in simulation and on hardware across beam widths and payload configurations. The results show that implicit dynamics features accelerate training, while explicit inertial estimation further improves traversal success; combining both enables LOAD to approach the performance of a privileged policy supplied with ground-truth inertial parameters. Hardware experiments demonstrate traversal with unilateral payloads of 6 kg on a 10 cm beam and 9 kg on a 15 cm beam, and an evenly distributed 11 kg payload on a 15 cm beam. These results support combining physical estimates and history features for precision locomotion under unknown loads.

摘要（中文）：未知载荷会改变机器人动力学特性，并在立足点余量较小时使精确接触执行变得困难。我们提出LOAD，一种感知运动框架，将显式惯性估计与隐式动力学特征相结合，用于窄梁穿越。分离的循环模块从本体感觉中推断躯干惯性变化及任务相关历史信息，同时将高度图教师模型蒸馏为基于深度图像的学生模型。我们在仿真和硬件上，针对不同梁宽和载荷配置，对LOAD及其变体进行了广泛评估。结果表明，隐式动力学特征加速了训练，而显式惯性估计进一步提高了穿越成功率；两者结合使LOAD能够接近具备真实惯性参数的特权策略的性能。硬件实验展示了在10厘米梁上携带6千克单侧载荷、在15厘米梁上携带9千克单侧载荷，以及在15厘米梁上均匀分布11千克载荷的穿越能力。这些结果支持将物理估计与历史特征相结合，以实现未知载荷下的精确运动。

Authors: Kunzhao Ren, Zhishuo Zhu, Xiaobin Xiong

GLST: Global-Local Spatio-Temporal Memory Decomposition Framework for Online Chained-Goal Navigation Locomotion

online chained-goal navigation memory decomposition spatio-temporal belief learning goal-conditioned rewards real-robot validation

简要说明：GLST提出了一种将潜在信念分解为全局-局部空间和长-短期时间表示的记忆分解框架，并结合目标条件奖励，在仿真和真实Spot机器人上提升了在线链式目标导航的性能。

TLDR: GLST introduces a memory decomposition framework separating global-local spatial and long-short temporal latent beliefs, coupled with goal-conditioned rewards, to improve online chained-goal navigation under evolving goals in simulation and on a real Spot robot.

Abstract: Autonomous navigation in real-world environments often requires long-horizon operation under partial observability and evolving goals. Existing mapless navigation approaches predominantly assume fixed goals throughout an episode, limiting applicability to practical scenarios where goals change online during execution. We study online chained-goal navigation, where goals evolve through existing-goal redirection or new-goal emergence without explicit transition signals. Under this setting, we find navigation may require either continued exploration or strategic revisitation, creating conflicting memory requirements. We propose Global-Local Spatio-Temporal Belief Learning (GLST), a memory-decomposition framework that separates latent beliefs into global-local spatial and long-short temporal representations for long-horizon reasoning. We further introduce goal-conditioned rewards to balance exploration and exploitation under evolving goals. Extensive experiments in simulation across diverse terrains demonstrate improved chained-goal navigation performance over baselines. Real-robot experiments using the Spot quadruped further validate our memory decomposition framework.

摘要（中文）：现实环境中的自主导航通常需要在部分可观测和动态变化目标条件下进行长时程操作。现有的无地图导航方法大多假设整个任务周期内目标固定不变，这限制了其在目标在线动态变化的实际场景中的适用性。本文研究了在线链式目标导航问题，其中目标通过既有目标重定向或新目标涌现而演化，且无显式转换信号。在该设定下，我们发现导航可能既需要持续探索，又需要策略性重访，从而产生相互冲突的记忆需求。我们提出全局-局部时空信念学习框架（GLST），这是一种记忆分解方法，将潜在信念分离为全局-局部空间表示和长-短时间表示，以实现长时程推理。我们进一步引入目标条件奖励，以在目标演化过程中平衡探索与利用。在多种地形的仿真实验中，该方法相较于基线方法在链式目标导航性能上有所提升。使用Spot四足机器人进行的真实机器人实验进一步验证了我们的记忆分解框架的有效性。

Authors: Yousef Liang, Ryan Ardalan, Yarden Goraly, Chenhao Zhu, Yue Yin, Jonas Frey, Claire Tomlin, Marco Pavone, Shankar Sastry

LAG-IO: Multi-IMU State Estimation for Legged Robots Using Factor Graphs Locomotion

factor graph multi-IMU state estimation legged robots zero-velocity update contact detection

简要说明：LAG-IO提出了一种基于因子图的多IMU状态估计框架，用于腿式机器人，通过紧密耦合机身和腿部IMU、关节编码器以及概率接触检测模块，提高了在挑战性地形下的轨迹精度和鲁棒性。

TLDR: LAG-IO introduces a factor graph-based multi-IMU state estimation framework for legged robots, tightly coupling body and leg-mounted IMUs with joint encoders and a probabilistic contact detection module to improve trajectory accuracy and robustness in challenging terrains.

Abstract: Robust proprioceptive state estimation is crucial for legged robots, particularly in challenging environments where exteroceptive sensors are unreliable. While traditional leg odometry typically relies on a single body-mounted inertial measurement unit (IMU) fused with leg kinematics via an extended Kalman filter (EKF), such methods are vulnerable to linearization errors and hard-contact assumptions, leading to severe drift during slippage or dynamic locomotion.In this paper, we propose LAG-IO, a factor graph-based multi-IMU state estimation framework that tightly couples measurements from a main body IMU, multiple leg-mounted IMUs, and joint encoders within a sliding-window optimization. To handle non-stationary foot-ground interactions, we introduce a continuous probabilistic contact detection module based on kernel density estimation (KDE), which adaptively scales the covariance of zero-velocity update (ZUPT) factors. Furthermore, kinematic relative position factors are formulated to structurally anchor the independent leg inertial states to the robot's main body. Experimental results on a quadruped robot across various unstructured terrains demonstrate that, compared to existing baselines, LAG-IO achieves higher planar trajectory accuracy, reduces unobservable vertical divergence, and provides smoother trajectory transitions during unstable contacts, while maintaining competitive attitude observability.

Authors: Yicheng Zhou, Longwen Chen, Qinghua Yu, Junhao Xiao, Huimin Lu, Xieyuanli Chen

Learning Robot Policies for Whole-Body Mobility Assistance via Dynamic Human Motion Generation Manipulation

whole-body assistive robotics diffusion policies human motion generation sim-to-real transfer mobile manipulator

简要说明：本文提出一个基于仿真的框架，利用对抗运动先验训练的人类策略生成逼真的护理对象响应，从而通过3D扩散策略学习全身辅助机器人策略，用于坐站和抬举转移任务，并初步展示了仿真到现实的迁移。

TLDR: This paper presents a simulation-based framework that uses a human policy trained with an adversarial motion prior to generate realistic care-recipient responses, enabling the learning of whole-body assistive robot policies for sit-to-stand and lift-and-transfer tasks via 3D diffusion policies, with initial sim-to-real transfer demonstrated.

Abstract: Robotic assistance for human mobility could benefit care recipients and reduce caregiver burden during physically demanding tasks such as Sit-to-Stand (STS) and Lift-and-Transfer (L&T). Learning robot policies for these whole-body assistive tasks is challenging: real-world data collection for human-robot interaction is costly and safety-critical, making simulation an attractive alternative. Prior work, however, typically treats the human as static or minimally responsive and thus fails to capture the cooperative nature of mobility assistance. We present a simulation-based framework for learning whole-body assistive robot policies. At its core is a human policy trained with an adversarial motion prior that produces realistic care-recipient motion in response to the robot's actions. A human-adaptive scripted controller interacts with this policy to collect diverse robot demonstrations at scale. From these demonstrations, we train 3D diffusion policies that map segmented human point clouds and robot joint positions to whole-body actions for a mobile manipulator, without relying on privileged human state at deployment. The resulting robot policies successfully perform both STS and L&T assistance in simulation. Preliminary experiments further demonstrate sim-to-real transfer for STS after fine-tuning on a small amount of real-world data. Videos are available on our project page: https://rchi-lab.github.io/human-gen-mobility-assistance/

HelpMeOut: A Neuropsychology-Grounded Benchmark for Error-Aware Monitoring of Household Task Execution Other

benchmark error monitoring household tasks embodied AI assistive agents

简要说明：HelpMeOut 提出了一个用于错误感知家庭任务执行监控的基准，针对认知障碍或老年人，评估了几种基线监控器并显示其表现不佳，凸显了辅助具身AI的空白。

TLDR: HelpMeOut introduces a benchmark for error-aware monitoring of household task execution, targeting cognitively impaired or older adults, and evaluates several baseline monitors showing they perform poorly, highlighting a gap in assistive embodied AI.

Abstract: We introduce HelpMeOut, an embodied AI benchmark for error-aware monitoring of household task execution. Existing embodied household benchmarks typically assume that humans execute tasks correctly, but this assumption does not hold for cognitively impaired persons or older adults whose everyday activities produce structured execution errors. To address this gap, HelpMeOut operationalizes research on everyday action errors into 20000 paired activity episodes, covering nine neuropsychologically motivated error categories. In each episode, agents observe a streaming human activity trajectory and must monitor whether the execution is unfolding correctly, diagnosing any structured errors as early as possible. We evaluate learned-monitor, symbolic, change-point, and frontier LLM prompting baselines. Results show that these methods perform poorly as error monitors, often missing when execution goes wrong. These results suggest a gap left by standard goal-inference and task-completion benchmarks, making HelpMeOut a testbed for error-aware assistive agents.

Authors: Haoran Wang, Jingwei Huang, Anqing Duan, Ho Seok Ahn, Bruce Macdonald

Towards a Systematic Study of Embodied System 2 over Full Task Execution Cycles Other

embodied reasoning closed-loop evaluation task execution recovery evidence memory

简要说明：本文介绍了SCOPER，一个用于评估和改进完整任务执行周期中具身系统2推理的套件，涵盖模拟器和真实机器人演示中的规划、执行与恢复，并通过证据记忆和进度验证显著提升了性能。

TLDR: This paper introduces SCOPER, a suite for evaluating and improving embodied System 2 reasoning across full task execution cycles, including planning, execution, and recovery in simulators and real-robot demos, demonstrating significant improvements with a harness of evidence memory and progress verification.

Abstract: An embodied brain, or System 2, must turn an abstract goal into actions while discovering relevant scene conditions and checking whether executed skills achieved their intended effects. Open-loop evaluations cannot test observations shaped by an agent's decisions, while some closed-loop evaluations provide limited evidence during execution or assume idealized skill outcomes. We introduce SCOPER, a suite for studying observation-grounded planning, execution, and recovery. SCOPER-bench combines high-level goals, ongoing visual observations, a shared rule-based System 1 for low-level actions, and controlled execution failures. Its construction and validation pipeline yields 870 tasks across BEHAVIOR and ProcTHOR, complemented by about 3,500 situated questions tied to the evaluated agent's execution. Benchmark results reveal difficulties in retaining scene evidence, monitoring progress, and recovering from unexpected outcomes. To address these difficulties, SCOPER-harness combines Evidence Memory and Progress Verification with a dynamic task agenda and bounded exploration, without additional model training. Across two evaluated open-source backbones and two simulators, the harness improves task success by 11.1-28.6%; a harnessed 9B model outperforms a directly executed 27B model on both simulators. In an offline next-action evaluation using observations from 200 real-robot demonstrations, the harness also improves full-call accuracy by 14.7% and 15.3%. SCOPER provides a setting for diagnosing and improving embodied reasoning throughout a complete task execution cycle.

摘要（中文）：具身大脑，或称系统2，必须将抽象目标转化为具体行动，同时发现相关场景条件，并检验已执行的技能是否达成了预期效果。开环评估无法测试由智能体决策所塑造的观察结果，而某些闭环评估在执行过程中仅能提供有限的证据，或假设技能成果理想化。我们引入了SCOPER，一个用于研究基于观察的规划、执行与恢复的套件。SCOPER-bench结合了高层次目标、持续视觉观察、共享的基于规则的初级动作系统1，以及可控的执行故障。其构建与验证流程在BEHAVIOR和ProcTHOR上生成了870项任务，并辅以约3500个与被评估智能体执行过程相关的情境化问题。基准测试结果揭示了在保留场景证据、监控进展以及从意外结果中恢复方面的困难。为解决这些困难，SCOPER-harness将证据记忆与进度验证相结合，并引入动态任务议程和有限探索，无需额外模型训练。在两个评估的开源骨干模型和两个模拟器中，该套件将任务成功率提升了11.1%至28.6%；在两个模拟器上，配备该套件的9B模型均优于直接执行的27B模型。在利用200次真实机器人演示观察进行的离线下一步动作评估中，该套件还将全调用准确率分别提升了14.7%和15.3%。SCOPER为在整个任务执行周期中诊断和改进具身推理提供了一个测试环境。

Authors: Yuxi Wei, Ye Fang, Shuai Yang, Tong Wu, Tai Wang, Xiaojuan Qi

Code2Worlds-2: Physically Plausible Agent Harness for Embodied World Simulation WorldModel

embodied world simulation simulator-compatible scene generation physics-based refinement MuJoCo MJCF rigid and articulated dynamics

简要说明：Code2Worlds-2 通过添加 SimReady 场景编译器和仿真器在环 4D 细化器，将 LLM 合成的 4D 世界转换为物理模拟器兼容的场景，实现具身世界模拟和机器人交互。

TLDR: Code2Worlds-2 converts LLM-synthesized 4D worlds into physics-simulator-compatible scenes by adding a SimReady Scene Compiler and a Simulator-in-the-Loop 4D Refiner, enabling embodied world simulation with robot interaction.

Abstract: Recent coding large language models (LLMs) can synthesize dynamic 4D worlds from natural language, but the resulting content remains a visual artifact. It lacks physical semantics such as the collision geometry, mass, friction, inertia, and joint structure, required to enable it to simulate the physical world, and its dynamics are scripted to look plausible rather than designed to execute. What is needed is an executable world: one that a physics engine can load and step, resolving contact physically. We present Code2Worlds-2, an extension of Code2Worlds that turns 4D world generation into an embodied world simulation. We keep the original dual-stream generation pipeline intact and append two modules. First, a SimReady Scene Compiler that turns a generated visual scene into a simulator-compatible representation: it assigns collision meshes via convex decomposition, estimates physical attributes with a vision-language model, infers a lightweight support graph, instantiates the engine's contact, friction, and dynamics constraints, and applies a gravity settling pass, before exporting the scene as MuJoCo MJCF. Second, a Simulator-in-the-Loop 4D Refiner that implements an automated agent harness-a compile, simulate, critique and refine loop-that converts visual dynamics into executable rigid and articulated dynamics and evolves the physical settings rather than only the code, replacing the purely visual motion critic with a simulator critic that inspects penetration depth, collision pairs, stability, contact forces, joint limits, and robot reachability. We further propose SimCode4D, a state-based benchmark with five task templates for evaluating embodied simulation. Experiments on SimCode4D and across natural, indoor, industrial, urban, and service scenes show that Code2Worlds-2 produces physically plausible, simulator-compatible, and robot-interactable scenes.

摘要（中文）：近期编码大型语言模型（LLMs）能够从自然语言合成动态4D世界，但生成的内容仍仅是视觉产物，缺乏物理语义，如碰撞几何、质量、摩擦力、惯性和关节结构等，这些属性对于模拟物理世界至关重要；其动态效果为脚本化呈现，旨在视觉上逼真，而非面向实际执行。所需的是一个可执行的世界：能够被物理引擎加载并进行逐步推进，以物理方式解决接触问题。我们提出Code2Worlds-2，作为Code2Worlds的扩展，将4D世界生成转化为具身世界模拟。我们保留原有的双流生成管线不变，并附加两个模块。首先，SimReady场景编译器将生成的视觉场景转换为模拟器兼容的表示：通过凸分解分配碰撞网格，利用视觉语言模型估计物理属性，推断轻量级支撑图，实例化引擎的接触、摩擦和动力学约束，并应用重力沉降过程，随后将场景导出为MuJoCo MJCF格式。其次，模拟器在环4D精炼器实现了一个自动化智能体框架——即编译、模拟、批判和精炼循环——将视觉动态转化为可执行的刚性及关节动力学，并演化物理设置而非仅修改代码，用模拟器批判器取代纯视觉运动批判器，检查穿透深度、碰撞对、稳定性、接触力、关节限制及机器人可达性。我们还提出了SimCode4D，一个基于状态基准测试，包含五种任务模板，用于评估具身模拟。在SimCode4D以及自然、室内、工业、城市和服务场景上的实验表明，Code2Worlds-2生成的场景在物理上合理、与模拟器兼容且可供机器人交互。

Authors: Haoyu Zhang, Siming Li, Zeyu Zhang, Yi Zhang, Tat-Seng Chua, Hao Tang

ATOM: Abstract Transition and Option Modeling - Experience-Informed Hierarchical Navigation VLN

hierarchical navigation option policies 3D scene graphs planning F1Tenth

简要说明：ATOM提出了一种结合图规划与可复用选项策略的分层导航框架，在3D场景图和F1Tenth车辆上验证，显著降低重复规划时间并保持轨迹效率。

TLDR: ATOM presents a hierarchical navigation framework integrating graph planning with reusable option policies, validated in 3D scene graphs and on an F1Tenth vehicle, significantly reducing repeated planning time while maintaining trajectory efficiency.

Abstract: We propose ATOM (Abstract Transition and Option Modeling), a hierarchical navigation framework that combines higher-level graph planning with reusable lower-level option policies for efficient repeated navigation in large-scale 3D environments represented by hierarchical structures such as 3D scene graphs (3DSGs). ATOM operates on a hierarchical graph representation, implemented using, for instance, the Rooms and Places layers of a 3DSG, where each directed abstract transition is associated with a navigation option. For each transition, ATOM computes and stores a reusable option policy along with its state-dependent cost-to-go. Across repeated navigation tasks, ATOM maintains a smoothed empirical distribution over option initiation states and uses it to progressively refine the corresponding abstract transition cost. Ablation studies show that ATOM reduces cumulative repeated-planning time by 97.5% relative to a monolithic MDP baseline while maintaining trajectories within approximately 7% of a Global Places A* shortest-path reference. Experience-informed refinement further reduces abstract transition-cost estimation error by 10.3%. Physical experiments validate ATOM on an F1Tenth vehicle, successfully completing all five navigation queries with 43% of inter-region option executions reusing previously generated solutions.

摘要（中文）：我们提出ATOM（抽象转移与选项建模），这是一种分层导航框架，结合了高层图规划与可复用的低层选项策略，以在由三维场景图（3DSGs）等分层结构表示的大规模3D环境中实现高效的重复导航。ATOM基于分层图表示运行，例如使用3DSG的“房间”和“场所”层实现，其中每个有向抽象转移都与一个导航选项相关联。对于每次转移，ATOM计算并存储一个可复用的选项策略及其依赖状态的目标代价。在重复导航任务中，ATOM维持对选项起始状态的经验分布进行平滑更新，并利用该分布逐步优化相应的抽象转移代价。消融研究表明，与整体MDP基线相比，ATOM将重复规划累计时间减少了97.5%，同时保持轨迹与全局场所A*最短路径参考的偏差约在7%以内。经验驱动的细化进一步将抽象转移代价估计误差降低了10.3%。物理实验在F1Tenth车辆上验证了ATOM，成功完成了全部五次导航查询，其中43%的区域间选项执行复用了先前生成的解决方案。

Authors: Changxuan Yao, Panagiotis Tsiotras

Act4R: Action-conditioned 4D reconstruction for kinematics-free control Manipulation

4D representation learning scene flow prediction inverse control action-conditioned robot control

简要说明：Act4R提出了一种基于动作条件的4D重建框架，从2D观测和动作信号预测机器人的3D场景流，从而实现无运动学逆控制，适用于多种机器人形态。

TLDR: Act4R introduces an action-conditioned 4D reconstruction framework that predicts a robot's 3D scene flow from 2D observations and action signals, enabling inverse control for kinematics-free control across various embodiments.

Abstract: Precise control of movement across various robotic embodiments is a longstanding challenge. Modeling complex robotic structures requires significant time, dedicated sensors, and manual labeling. Recent advancements in 4D representation learning offer an interesting alternative: can we leverage 4D features lifted from 2D observations to densely map a robot's spatial movement based on the action signal? To this end, we propose Act4R, a framework that builds on 3D foundation model to predict a robot's 3D scene flow with any given action. Act4R introduces a Spatial-Action Encoder, which encodes the current 2D robot state and its action signals into embeddings that represent future robot state in 3D. Then, both the current and future spatial embeddings are decoded into point maps to estimate action-conditioned scene flow. To effectively learn the mapping between action and future state, Act4R introduces spatial-action fusion in its transformer-based encoder, and a spatial alignment loss that guides the encoder for future flow prediction. After training on some samples of a given embodiment, Act4R can perform inverse control by optimizing the signal to achieve the desired scene flow. We evaluate Act4R on a public real-world dataset and synthetic data collected in simulator. Experiments on various robotic platforms show that Act4R outperforms the previous SoTA in scene flow prediction. Our method also performs better in inverse control, both on the action accuracy metric and in closed-loop control in simulation.

摘要（中文）：对多种机器人形态实现精准运动控制一直是一项长期挑战。对复杂机器人结构进行建模需要耗费大量时间、专用传感器以及人工标注。近期4D表示学习的进展提供了一种有趣的替代思路：我们能否利用从2D观测中提取的4D特征，基于动作信号对机器人的空间运动进行密集映射？为此，我们提出了Act4R框架，该框架基于3D基础模型，预测机器人在给定任意动作下的3D场景流。Act4R引入了一种空间-动作编码器，将当前2D机器人状态及其动作信号编码为表示机器人未来3D状态的嵌入表示。随后，当前和未来的空间嵌入均被解码为点图，以估计基于动作条件的场景流。为了有效学习动作与未来状态之间的映射关系，Act4R在其基于Transformer的编码器中引入了空间-动作融合机制，并设计了空间对齐损失函数，以引导编码器进行未来流预测。在给定机器人形态的若干样本上完成训练后，Act4R可通过优化信号实现逆控制，从而达到期望的场景流。我们在公开的真实世界数据集及仿真器中采集的合成数据上对Act4R进行了评估。在多种机器人平台上的实验表明，Act4R在场景流预测方面优于现有的最先进方法。此外，在动作精度指标以及仿真中的闭环控制方面，我们的方法在逆控制任务中也表现更优。

Authors: Zhaoliang Zhang, Chenhao Yu, Zhimin Shao, Xijun Liu, Cheng Peng

Smoothness Ranks Skill, Not Success: An Audit of Published Trajectory-Smoothness Curation Metrics Under Episode-Length Controls Manipulation

trajectory smoothness imitation learning robomimic data curation behavior cloning

简要说明：本文审计了用于模仿学习的轨迹平滑度筛选指标，发现这些指标受回合长度混淆，无法预测任务成功，有时还会降低下游策略性能。

TLDR: This paper audits trajectory-smoothness curation metrics for imitation learning and finds they are confounded by episode length, failing to predict task success and sometimes reducing downstream policy performance.

Abstract: Trajectory smoothness has been proposed as a cheap, training-free signal for curating imitation-learning demonstrations, most recently by rinse, which introduces Spectral Arc Length (SAL) and a contact-aware Trajectory-Envelope Distance (TED). We test whether these published metrics survive episode-length controls on real robomimic data. On can/mh, SAL separates better from worse operators with AUROC 0.952, but episode length alone achieves 0.957, and inside a duration-matched band SAL falls to 0.628 while raw mean jerk, the baseline rinse argues against, rises to 0.896. The confound replicates on square/mh. On can/mg, where every episode is exactly 150 steps, SAL is at chance (0.454) and TED is inverted (0.376) against task success, while jerk reaches 0.706. Training GMM behavior-cloning policies on each metric's curated subset (10 seeds), curating by TED costs roughly a third of downstream success relative to random selection of the same size (0.240 vs. 0.360, p=0.0001, surviving Bonferroni correction), while SAL and jerk are indistinguishable from not curating. Under a diffusion policy TED still ranks worst, though its deficit is not resolvable at five seeds, and jerk becomes significantly better than both baselines, so the curation decision does not transfer unchanged across the two policy configurations we tested. Inspecting trajectories shows why TED inverts: successful manipulation requires sustained high-deviation motion through contact, while failure is low-amplitude hovering that a smoothed envelope follows closely.

摘要（中文）：轨迹平滑度已被提出作为一种廉价且无需训练的信号，用于筛选模仿学习示范数据，最近由rinse方法引入，该方法采用谱弧长（SAL）和接触感知的轨迹包络距离（TED）。我们检验这些已发表的指标是否在真实robomimic数据上经过回合长度控制后依然有效。在can/mh任务中，SAL能以AUROC 0.952区分较优与较劣的操作者，但仅凭回合长度即可达到0.957；在时长匹配的区间内，SAL降至0.628，而原始平均加加速度——即rinse所反对的基线方法——升至0.896。这一混淆现象在square/mh任务中重复出现。在can/mg任务中，所有回合恰好为150步，SAL的表现与随机猜测无异（0.454），TED相对于任务成功呈反向关系（0.376），而加加速度达到0.706。使用各指标筛选的子集训练高斯混合行为克隆策略（10个随机种子），相较于相同规模的随机选择，按TED筛选会使下游成功率损失约三分之一（0.240对0.360，p=0.0001，经Bonferroni校正后仍显著），而SAL和加加速度与不筛选无显著差异。在扩散策略下，TED仍排名最差，但其劣势在五个种子的条件下无法明确分辨，且加加速度显著优于两种基线方法，因此筛选决策在我们测试的两种策略配置之间不能不变地迁移。检查轨迹数据可揭示TED反向的原因：成功的操作需要持续的接触状态下的高偏差运动，而失败则是低振幅的悬停，平滑包络能紧密贴合这种运动。

Authors: Jaiveer Bassi

MIRROR: Reflecting Hidden Symmetries from Offline Robot Interaction Data Manipulation

symmetry-aware policy learning partially observable MDPs offline robot data frame-averaged behavior cloning tabletop manipulation

简要说明：MIRROR 从离线机器人数据中学习已知对称群在观察和动作上的联合作用，通过对抗性元组匹配和群一致性正则化，提升了帧平均行为克隆在操作任务中的数据效率和鲁棒性，并实现零样本迁移到真实机器人。

TLDR: MIRROR learns how known symmetry groups act on observations and actions in POMDPs from offline robot data via adversarial tuple matching and group-consistency regularization, improving data efficiency and robustness of frame-averaged behavior cloning for manipulation, with zero-shot transfer to a real robot.

Abstract: Symmetry-aware robot policy learning requires coupled observation-action transformations. For pixel observations, even simple physical symmetries can induce complex, viewpoint-dependent image transformations that are difficult to specify by hand. Existing symmetry-aware methods often rely on representations with predefined transformations, requiring preprocessing tailored to the sensing setup and task. We introduce MIRROR, a framework that learns how a known symmetry group operates jointly on observations and actions in partially observable Markov decision processes (POMDPs) from offline interaction data. MIRROR couples these transformations through adversarial tuple matching over one-step transition tuples, while explicit group-consistency regularization penalizes violations of the group-operation axioms. On four Robosuite tabletop manipulation tasks, MIRROR achieves the lowest aggregate error on three of four symmetry-quality metrics, including a 61% reduction in compatibility error (which measures consistency under transformation composition) relative to an adapted LaLiGAN baseline. Using the learned transformations in frame-averaged behavior cloning (BC) yields higher mean success rates than vanilla BC on all four tasks, increasing average success from 80.48% to 85.12%, with per-task gains up to 9.66 percentage points. We also repeat symmetry discovery and policy training in simulation with heightmap and segmentation-mask observations, then deploy the resulting policy zero-shot on a real Kinova GEN3 arm. Project page: https://pomdp-mirror.github.io.

摘要（中文）：对称感知的机器人策略学习需要观测-动作的耦合变换。对于像素观测而言，即使是简单的物理对称性也可能引发复杂的、依赖视角的图像变换，而这些变换难以人工指定。现有的对称感知方法通常依赖于具有预定义变换的表示形式，需要针对具体传感设置和任务进行专门预处理。我们提出了MIRROR框架，该框架能够从离线交互数据中学习已知对称群如何在部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程（POMDP）中联合作用于观测和动作。MIRROR通过单步转移元组上的对抗性元组匹配来耦合这些变换，同时通过显式的群一致性正则化来惩罚违反群运算公理的行为。在四个Robosuite桌面操作任务中，MIRROR在四项对称性质量指标中的三项上取得了最低的总误差，其中在兼容性误差（衡量变换组合下的一致性）上相较改进的LaLiGAN基线降低了61%。将学习到的变换用于帧平均行为克隆（BC）后，在所有四个任务上的平均成功率均高于原始BC，平均成功率从80.48%提升至85.12%，单项任务最高提升达9.66个百分点。我们还使用高度图和分割掩码观测在仿真中重复进行对称性发现和策略训练，然后将所得策略零样本部署到真实的Kinova GEN3机械臂上。项目主页：https://pomdp-mirror.github.io。

Authors: Shiqi Liu, Yihang Yao, Peide Huang, Mengdi Xu, Ding Zhao

ClearNav: Perception-Aligned Quadrotor Flight Using Differential-Physics RLRobot

quadrotor navigation perception-aligned differential-physics collision avoidance reinforcement learning

简要说明：ClearNav 提出了一种四旋翼导航策略，通过奖励项强制航向与飞行方向一致、惩罚横向速度并在障碍物附近降低速度，从而在仿真和真实环境中减少碰撞。

TLDR: ClearNav proposes a quadrotor navigation policy with reward terms that enforce forward-aligned heading, penalize lateral velocity, and reduce speed near obstacles, reducing collisions in cluttered environments in simulation and real-world tests.

Abstract: Autonomous quadrotor flight in cluttered environment is an key capability for tasks like inspection and search. Navigation policies trained in simulation and transferred to hardware can fly at high speed in open space, but they can still collide as obstacle clearance shrinks. We attribute most of these collisions to a single mechanism, namely motion in directions the onboard camera does not observe. Heading that is not aligned with the direction of travel and lateral excursion during obstacle avoidance both carry the vehicle toward obstacles outside its field of view. We introduce ClearNav, a navigation policy trained with two reward terms that constrain motion to the observed direction, a forward-looking heading target and a penalty on lateral velocity. A third term penalizes speed near obstacles so that an obstacle entering the field of view remains avoidable. In simulation, across 18 held-out scenarios with 2304 paired flights per policy unseen in training, ClearNav improves success by 6.8 points, cuts the collision rate by 65% relative to the state of the arts, and flies at maximum 5m/s. For the proximity term alone under matched commanded speeds, the collision reduction still holds at 70%. The effect is significant on static scenes and consistent in direction on moving obstacles, though not significant there at the suite level, showing that safer flight in clutter is possible even on the limited sensors and compute of small drones. We also validate our navigation policy in a real-world cluttered environment, showing that it enables the quadrotor to navigate through the cluttered environment successfully and safely.

摘要（中文）：自主四旋翼飞行器在杂乱环境中的飞行是巡检和搜索等任务的关键能力。在仿真环境中训练并迁移至硬件的导航策略能够在开放空间中高速飞行，但随着障碍物间隙缩小，仍可能发生碰撞。我们将大多数此类碰撞归因于单一机制，即飞行器沿机载相机未观测方向运动。机头朝向与飞行方向不一致，以及避障过程中的侧向偏移，都会使飞行器朝向视野之外的障碍物移动。我们提出ClearNav，一种导航策略，训练时引入两项奖励项以约束运动沿观测方向进行，包括前视机头朝向目标和侧向速度惩罚。第三项奖励项在障碍物附近施加速度惩罚，使得进入视野的障碍物仍可被规避。在仿真中，跨越18个训练中未见过的留出场景，每个策略包含2304次配对飞行，ClearNav将成功率提升了6.8个百分点，相较于现有最优方法将碰撞率降低了65%，并实现最高5 m/s的飞行速度。仅就接近项而言，在匹配指令速度条件下，碰撞率降低仍保持在70%。该效果在静态场景中显著，在动态障碍物上方向一致，但在整体场景集水平上不够显著，这表明即使在小型无人机有限传感器和计算资源下，杂乱环境中的安全飞行仍是可行的。我们还在真实世界的杂乱环境中验证了导航策略，结果表明该策略能使四旋翼飞行器成功且安全地穿越杂乱环境。

Authors: Aditya Azad, Arthur Huang, Guanrui Li

Evaluating Long-Horizon Robot Planning under Uncertainty Manipulation

long-horizon planning household robots Habitat uncertainty ReAct

简要说明：该论文在Habitat中提出了一个包含七个长时程家庭任务的基准，用于评估不同机器人在不确定性下的规划器，发现ReAct成功率最高，但准确的初始记忆并不总是带来最佳性能。

TLDR: This paper introduces a benchmark of seven long-horizon household tasks in Habitat to evaluate different robot planners under uncertainty, finding that ReAct achieves the highest success rate but accurate initial memory does not always benefit performance.

Abstract: Household robots must successfully navigate im-perfect circumstances, both in their internal models and the external world. We introduce a benchmark of seven long-horizon household tasks in Habitat that vary initial robot memory and environment configurations. We evaluate adaptations of ReAct, VLM-TAMP, and Tru-POMDP within a shared execution framework across 90 tasks-environment-memory combinations, totaling 1,350 episodes. Our evaluation measures task success, partial completion, and action efficiency, along with rule-based analysis of execution traces. ReAct achieves the highest overall task success (45.3%) and completion (71.7%), while having accurate initial memory does not consistently yield the highest performance for every planner. We identify recurring placement errors, precondition errors, and redundant actions through trace analysis. These findings highlight differences in how the evaluated planners use initial knowledge and respond to uncertainty.

摘要（中文）：家庭机器人必须能够在内部模型和外部世界均不完美的情况下成功导航。我们引入了一个包含七项长期家庭任务的基准测试，该测试在Habitat环境中进行，涉及不同的初始机器人记忆和环境配置。我们在一个共享执行框架内，对ReAct、VLM-TAMP和Tru-POMDP的适配版本进行了评估，覆盖90种任务-环境-记忆组合，总计1，350个回合。我们的评估衡量了任务成功率、部分完成度及行动效率，并结合基于规则的执行轨迹分析。ReAct实现了最高的整体任务成功率（45.3%）和完成度（71.7%），而拥有准确的初始记忆并不总是能为每个规划器带来最优性能。通过轨迹分析，我们识别出反复出现的放置错误、前提条件错误和冗余动作。这些发现凸显了所评估的规划器在利用初始知识和应对不确定性方面的差异。
