Authors: Harsh Muriki, Gayathri Aravindan, Yuchen Zheng, Sonia Chernova

Improving Policy Learning from Delayed Interventions RLRobot

imitation learning expert interventions delayed intervention cost function policy learning

简要说明：本文研究了机器人模仿学习中专家干预延迟的影响，表明延迟干预不如即时干预有效，并提出LfDI方法，通过从延迟干预中学习代价函数来提供额外监督，从而改进策略学习。

TLDR: The paper studies the effect of delayed expert interventions in imitation learning for robotic systems, showing it is less effective than immediate intervention, and proposes LfDI, a method that learns a cost function from delayed interventions to provide additional supervision and improve policy learning.

Abstract: In this work, we explore the idea of expert intervention delays in human-supervised robotic systems for imitation learning system. Previous works in imitation learning have primarily examined the impact of suboptimal experts, where the expert policy makes mistakes, but assumed expert interventions occur immediately after errors are made. Although delayed expert intervention can be viewed as a form of noise that might improve policy robustness, our results show that learning from delayed expert interventions is overall less effective than learning from non-delayed expert interventions; delayed expert interventions are less effective at demonstrating error avoidance behaviors. To address this, we propose Learning from Delayed Intervention (LfDI), which learns a cost function based on where and when the expert intervenes, combined with limited information about the extent of intervention delays provided by the expert. This cost function is then used to infer additional supervision for states without expert data, guiding the policy to avoid states that would likely trigger interventions. We evaluate our method, Learning from Delayed Intervention (LfDI), on simulated environments and show that it outperforms other methods that do not account for intervention delays.

摘要（中文）：在本研究中，我们探讨了人类监督机器人系统中，模仿学习框架下专家干预延迟的概念。以往关于模仿学习的研究主要聚焦于次优专家的影响，即专家策略可能出现错误，但假设专家在错误发生之后立即实施干预。尽管延迟的专家干预可视为一种可能增强策略鲁棒性的噪声形式，我们的研究结果显示，从延迟的专家干预中学习总体上不如从非延迟干预中学习有效；延迟的专家干预在展示错误规避行为方面效果欠佳。为应对这一问题，我们提出了延迟干预学习（LfDI）方法，该方法基于专家进行干预的位置和时间，结合专家提供的关于干预延迟程度的有限信息，来学习一个成本函数。随后，该成本函数被用于为缺乏专家数据的状态推断额外的监督信号，引导策略避开可能触发干预的状态。我们在模拟环境中对我们的方法——延迟干预学习（LfDI）——进行了评估，结果表明它优于其他未考虑干预延迟的方法。

Authors: Xiru Zhu, David Meger, Gregory Dudek

ReForesight: Occlusion-Robust Re-Identification and Future Occupancy Forecasting for Dynamic Semantic Mapping Perception3D

future occupancy forecasting semantic mapping re-identification MLP ROS 2

简要说明：ReForesight 是一个 ROS 2 工具包，为共享人行道中的机器人语义地图增加实时实例级未来占用预测和遮挡后重新识别，使用轻量级 MLP 改进对行人和车辆的轨迹预测。

TLDR: ReForesight is a ROS 2 toolkit that adds real-time instance-level future occupancy prediction and re-identification after occlusion to semantic mapping for robots in shared walkways, improving trajectory forecasting for tracked people and vehicles using a lightweight MLP.

Abstract: Robots sharing walkways need to know where people will be, yet semantic occupancy maps show only where they are. We present ReForesight, an open-source ROS 2 toolkit that adds instance-level future occupancy and re-identification after occlusion to a particle-based semantic mapping pipeline. A 36.6k-parameter MLP predicts each tracked person or vehicle up to 3 s ahead, guarded by a Kalman fallback and a stationary gate, and the object's own points are moved to the forecast pose, forming a "ghost" point cloud in the map frame without an occupancy decoder. An optional tracker re-associates objects after occlusion using keypoint descriptors the pipeline already computes and a metric 3D gate. On four held-out CODa sequences, the MLP lowers the mean 3 s final displacement error from 0.728 m (Kalman) to 0.662 m and beats a similar-size GRU (0.692 m) on every sequence, at 0.04 ms per instance on one CPU core. Code, all models, and a ROS-free demo are released; field demonstrations use an outdoor cleaning robot.

摘要（中文）：共享步行空间的机器人需要知道人们将要去往何处，而语义占用地图仅能显示他们当前所在的位置。我们提出了ReForesight，一个开源的ROS 2工具包，它在基于粒子的语义建图流程中增加了实例级未来占用以及遮挡后的重新识别功能。一个36.6k参数的MLP可预测每个被追踪的行人或车辆未来最多3秒的位置，并以卡尔曼滤波回退和静止门控作为保障，同时将对象自身的点移动到预测位姿，从而在地图坐标系中形成“幽灵”点云，无需占用解码器。可选的追踪器利用该流程已有的关键点描述符和度量3D门控，在遮挡后重新关联对象。在四个保留的CODa序列上，MLP将平均3秒最终位移误差从0.728米（卡尔曼）降低至0.662米，并在每个序列上均优于参数规模相近的GRU（0.692米），单个CPU核心上每实例处理耗时0.04毫秒。代码、所有模型以及一个不依赖ROS的演示均已发布；实地演示采用了户外清洁机器人。

Authors: Didar Seyidov, Faith Ogunwoye, Hajira Amjad, Danil Tolkachev, Yuri Sarkisov, Dzmitry Tsetserukou

Physical SLAM: Physics-aware Simultaneous Localisation and Mapping Other

Physical SLAM dynamic Gaussian radiance fields spring–mass model action-conditioned simulation deformable objects

简要说明：Physical SLAM 从单目视频中联合重建动态高斯辐射场并推断其物理动力学，利用弹簧-质量模型和虚拟观测力实现可变形物体在外部作用下的未来状态预测，在重建、预测和相机跟踪精度上优于现有SLAM基线。

TLDR: Physical SLAM jointly reconstructs dynamic Gaussian radiance fields and infers their underlying physics from monocular video, using a spring-mass model with virtual observation forces to enable action-conditioned future-state prediction for deformable objects. It improves reconstruction, prediction, and camera tracking accuracy over prior SLAM baselines.

Abstract: To reconstruct a predictive 4D representation of the physical world from monocular video captured by a moving camera, we jointly reconstruct dynamic Gaussian radiance fields and infer their underlying physical dynamics. This paper proposes \emph{Physical SLAM}, a physics-aware method for constructing 4D Gaussian fields of deformable objects and predicting their future state when subjected to external actions, given a sequence of RGB-D images. Our method separates the scene into a static background Gaussian field for camera localization and a dynamic object Gaussian field driven by a spring--mass physical model of elastic deformation, inertia, and damping. To integrate visual observations with physical dynamics, we introduce virtual observation forces that gradually pull simulated surface nodes toward observed depth points, avoiding abrupt replacement of simulated node positions. Meanwhile, the physical parameters of the spring--mass model are updated from simulation errors aggregated over the full reconstruction observation window, enabling the reconstructed dynamics to align with observations. To couple appearance, geometry, and physics, we further design a physics-aware Gaussian transformation and surface alignment strategy, where dynamic Gaussians are transformed along the deforming physical surface of the spring--mass model and constrained to remain aligned with the surface during rendering-based optimization. The resulting representation supports observed-frame rendering and action-conditioned simulation, extending SLAM maps to describe how deformable objects respond to manipulation. On the PhysTwin benchmark, our method improves reconstruction and prediction PSNR over PhysTwin by 10.4\% and 11.0\%, respectively. On the TUM RGB-D benchmark, it reduces average camera tracking error by 20.6\%, improves SSIM by 3.6\%, and reduces LPIPS by 8.3\% compared with 4DGS-SLAM.

摘要（中文）：为了从运动相机拍摄的单目视频中重建物理世界的预测性4D表示，我们联合重建动态高斯辐射场并推断其底层的物理动力学。本文提出\textbf{Physical SLAM}，一种物理感知方法，用于构建可变形物体的4D高斯场，并在给定RGB-D图像序列时预测其在外部作用下的未来状态。我们的方法将场景分离为用于相机定位的静态背景高斯场和由弹性变形、惯性和阻尼的弹簧-质量物理模型驱动的动态物体高斯场。为了将视觉观测与物理动力学整合，我们引入了虚拟观测力，逐步将模拟表面节点拉向观测到的深度点，避免对模拟节点位置的突然替换。同时，弹簧-质量模型的物理参数根据整个重建观测窗口内聚合的模拟误差进行更新，从而使重建的动力学与观测保持一致。为了将外观、几何和物理耦合起来，我们进一步设计了物理感知的高斯变换和表面对齐策略，其中动态高斯沿弹簧-质量模型的变形物理表面进行变换，并在基于渲染的优化过程中保持与表面对齐。由此产生的表示支持观测帧渲染和动作条件仿真，将SLAM地图扩展为描述可变形物体对操作的响应。在PhysTwin基准上，我们的方法在重建和预测PSNR上分别比PhysTwin提高了10.4\%和11.0\%。在TUM RGB-D基准上，与4DGS-SLAM相比，平均相机跟踪误差降低了20.6\%，SSIM提高了3.6\%，LPIPS降低了8.3\%。

Authors: Guangming Wang, Zhishuo Liu, Haibing Wu, Wanli Ma, Yixiong Jing, Olaf Wysocki, Brian Sheil

Value-Preserving Action Quantization Manipulation

action quantization Monte Carlo tree search state reachability behavioral cloning object pushing

简要说明：本文提出价值保持的动作量化（VAQ），通过保持状态可达性而非重建误差来量化连续动作，并将其与MCTS结合（VAQ-MCTS）用于行为克隆，在物体推挤任务中展示了更高的数据效率、鲁棒性和零样本适应性，并在真实硬件上完成30次试验。

TLDR: This paper introduces value-preserving action quantization (VAQ), which quantizes continuous actions for search-based robot policies by preserving state reachability rather than reconstruction error, and combines it with MCTS (VAQ-MCTS) for behavioral cloning, demonstrating improved data efficiency, robustness, and zero-shot adaptation in object pushing tasks on real hardware.

Abstract: Search-based policy learning, such as Monte Carlo tree search (MCTS), offers the flexibility to trade runtime computation for data efficiency and adaptation to novel environments. For robot learning, however, applying search requires discretizing the continuous action space and associated dynamics, typically through action quantization. While reconstruction-based quantization is sufficient for representing the continuous action space alone, policy learning additionally requires the quantized actions to preserve their effects on future states and values. We show that such requirement is not necessarily captured by action reconstruction error. Instead, we prove that the error in the value function resulting from action quantization is tightly bounded by the reconstruction error of state reachability under the quantized actions. Based on these results, we propose value-preserving action quantization (VAQ), which quantizes actions by preserving state reachability. We further combine VAQ with MCTS (VAQ-MCTS) as a value-preserving, search-based policy learning framework for behavioral cloning. Using a wide range of object pushing tasks as a controlled benchmark, we evaluate VAQ-MCTS against state-of-the-art behavioral cloning methods. VAQ-MCTS matches or exceeds their performance under standard settings, while substantially improving data efficiency and robustness to heterogeneous demonstrations, while enabling zero-shot adaptation to novel environments. Hardware experiments further demonstrate the effectiveness of VAQ-MCTS, completing all 30 real-world object pushing trials with only 10 minutes of demonstration data.

摘要（中文）：基于搜索的策略学习，如蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS），提供了灵活的交易运行时计算以换取数据效率和适应新环境的能力。然而，对于机器人学习而言，应用搜索需要对连续动作空间及相关动态进行离散化处理，通常通过动作量化来实现。虽然基于重建的量化足以单独表示连续动作空间，但策略学习还要求量化后的动作保持其对未来状态和值的影响。我们表明，这一需求不一定能通过动作重建误差来捕捉。相反，我们证明，由动作量化引起的值函数误差，在量化动作下紧密地由状态可达性的重建误差所界定。基于这些发现，我们提出了保持值的动作量化（VAQ），该方法通过保持状态可达性来量化动作。我们进一步将VAQ与MCTS结合（VAQ-MCTS），作为一种保持值的、基于搜索的策略学习框架，用于行为克隆。利用一系列物体推动任务作为受控基准，我们将VAQ-MCTS与最先进的行为克隆方法进行了评估。在标准设置下，VAQ-MCTS的表现与它们相当或更优，同时显著提高了数据效率和对异构演示的鲁棒性，并能实现对新环境的零样本适应。硬件实验进一步证明了VAQ-MCTS的有效性，仅用10分钟的演示数据便完成了全部30次真实世界的物体推动试验。

Authors: Max Muchen Sun, Jueun Kwon, Benjamin Riviere, Todd Murphey

MMTA: Benchmarking Multimodal Temporal Analysis with Time Series, Text, and Vision Other

multimodal temporal analysis benchmark time-series encoder multimodal large language model forecasting

简要说明：MMTA是一个跨机器人、驾驶等领域的三模态（时间序列、文本、视觉）基准，TimeOmni-v通过专用时间序列编码器和预测头提升了长视频分类与推理效率。

TLDR: MMTA is a tri-modal benchmark (time series, text, vision) spanning robotics, driving, and other domains, and TimeOmni-v is a multimodal LLM with a time-series encoder and forecasting head that improves performance and efficiency.

Abstract: Time-series analysis is increasingly studied in multimodal settings, yet most benchmarks pair temporal signals with text or with visualizations derived from the same signal. This leaves open whether multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can integrate time series with real-world visual evidence. We introduce MMTA (multimodal temporal analysis), a benchmark of tri-modal tasks with diverse cross-modal complementarity patterns among time series, text, and vision. MMTA spans nine domains -- robotics, autonomous driving, human action, manufacturing, AR assistance, healthcare, recommendation, finance, and climate -- under video+TS and image+TS layouts, with a 3,524-sample test split covering classification and forecasting. The benchmark standardizes heterogeneous real-world sources into a shared schema with domain-specific prompts, provenance documentation, and success-weighted metrics that penalize both wrong answers and failed generations. Evaluating eight open-source and proprietary MLLMs reveals a shared bottleneck: representing time series as text creates very long token sequences and weakens fine-grained alignment with visual evidence, especially in long-video settings. We then introduce TimeOmni-v, a multimodal LLM extension with a dedicated time-series encoder, temporal positional alignment, modality-aware token layout, and a forecasting head. TimeOmni-v improves long-video classification and time-series inference efficiency, showing that MMTA not only exposes representation and grounding failures but also motivates targeted model design.

摘要（中文）：时间序列分析在多模态场景中的研究日益增多，然而大多数基准测试仅将时间信号与文本或由同一信号衍生的可视化结果进行配对。这留下了这样一个问题：多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）能否将时间序列与真实世界的视觉证据相整合？我们引入了MMTA（多模态时间分析），这是一个三模态任务基准，涵盖时间序列、文本和视觉之间多样的跨模态互补模式。MMTA覆盖九个领域——机器人、自动驾驶、人类行为、制造业、AR辅助、医疗健康、推荐系统、金融和气候——采用视频+时间序列及图像+时间序列两种布局，测试集包含3，524个样本，涵盖分类和预测任务。该基准将异构的真实世界数据源标准化为共享模式，并配有领域特定提示、来源文档以及成功加权指标，该指标同时惩罚错误答案和生成失败。对八种开源和专有MLLMs的评估揭示了一个共同的瓶颈：将时间序列表示为文本会产生非常长的令牌序列，并削弱与视觉证据的细粒度对齐，尤其在长视频场景中更为突出。随后，我们提出了TimeOmni-v，一种多模态大语言模型扩展，配备专门的时间序列编码器、时间位置对齐、模态感知令牌布局以及预测头。TimeOmni-v提高了长视频分类和时间序列推理效率，表明MMTA不仅揭示了表示和基础对齐的失败，还推动了有针对性的模型设计。

Authors: Ziyang Zhang, Shenyi Li, Yilin Wang, Ziyun Cui, Bowen Zhou, Wen Wu, Chao Zhang

World-T3: Test-Time Training as Persistent Memory for Real-Time Video World Models WorldModel

video world model test-time training recursive least-squares camera-controlled generation distillation

简要说明：World-T3 提出了一种带测试时训练记忆的相机控制视频世界模型，通过递归最小二乘更新保持长时程生成的空间一致性，并蒸馏自回归模型为少步生成器以实现实时交互生成。

TLDR: World-T3 introduces a camera-controlled video world model with test-time training memory that uses recursive least-squares updates to maintain spatial consistency in long-horizon generation, and distills an autoregressive model into a few-step generator for real-time interactive generation.

Abstract: Recent advances in video world models have enabled plausible interactive environments, yet long-horizon generation places a fundamental demand on visual memory: the previously observed world must remain consistent as the model continues to generate. Existing autoregressive approaches often implicitly rely on the generative model itself to retain such information, leading to spatial memory decay beyond the active context. We introduce World-T3, a camera-controlled video world model with a test-time training memory that consolidates past observations into dedicated model parameters. To robustly update this memory, we propose a recursive least-squares rule that incrementally absorbs novel visual features via online pose-keyed memory updates. Our TTT memory reads out previously observed scene features from the fast-weight state by camera pose, enabling consistent generation with constant storage and per-step computation regardless of rollout length. To facilitate real-time interactive generation with this robust memory, we further distill the autoregressive model into a few-step generator via dual-teacher distribution matching. On a long-horizon revisit benchmark, World-T3 raises revisit PSNR from 13.52 to 18.31 dB and reduces absolute rotation error from 3.344 to 1.075 relative to the strongest baseline on both metrics, while sustaining 20.6 FPS at 1280 x 704 on a single NVIDIA B200 GPU.

摘要（中文）：近期在视频世界模型领域的进展使得生成逼真的交互环境成为可能，然而长时程生成对视觉记忆提出了根本性需求：在模型持续生成的过程中，先前观察到的世界必须保持一致。现有的自回归方法往往隐式依赖生成模型自身来保留此类信息，导致超出有效上下文范围后出现空间记忆衰减。我们提出了World-T3，一种带有测试时训练记忆的摄像机可控视频世界模型，该模型将过去的观测整合到专用模型参数中。为了稳健地更新这一记忆，我们提出了一种递归最小二乘规则，通过在线姿态键控记忆更新逐步吸收新的视觉特征。我们的TTT记忆通过摄像机姿态从快权重状态中读出先前观察到的场景特征，从而在滚动长度不限的情况下，以恒定存储和单步计算实现一致的生成。为了支持具备该稳健记忆的实时交互式生成，我们进一步通过双教师分布匹配将自回归模型蒸馏为少步生成器。在长时程重访基准测试中，World-T3将重访PSNR从13.52 dB提升至18.31 dB，并将绝对旋转误差从3.344降至1.075，两项指标均优于最强基线，同时在单块NVIDIA B200 GPU上以1280×704分辨率维持20.6 FPS的生成速度。

Authors: Junyi Wu, Zekun Li, Chenhongyi Yang, Chen Guo, Lingchen Yang, Yongan Zhang, Xinyi Zhang, Hongbing Hu, Bartek Rymkowski, Srinath Sridhar, Yan Yan, Xijie Huang

Plan-Bench: Can Existing VLMs Go Well Beyond Perception to Reason and Plan in Embodied Worlds? VLA

embodied planning VLM reasoning multi-step planning benchmark high-level decision

简要说明：Plan-Bench 是一个包含 699 个样本、跨越 16 个子类的基准，用于评估视觉语言模型在具身世界中独立于动作执行的高层推理和多步规划能力。对 28 个 VLM 的评估显示仍有很大提升空间，最强模型准确率为 75%，缩放趋势表明更大模型展现规划潜力。

TLDR: Plan-Bench is a benchmark with 699 curated samples across 16 subclasses to evaluate high-level reasoning and multi-step planning of VLMs in embodied worlds, independent of action execution. The evaluation of 28 VLMs shows significant room for improvement, with the best model achieving 75% accuracy and scaling trends indicating larger models show potential as planners.

Abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have achieved strong performance in visual perception and spatial reasoning, leading to growing interest in using them as high-level planners for embodied AI. However, physical tasks require models to integrate spatial information, reason over temporal states, and generate multi-step plans under various constraints, raising the question of whether current VLMs can reliably support such reasoning and planning independently of execution. We introduce Plan-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating the high-level reasoning and multi-step planning capabilities of VLMs relevant to embodied worlds, while isolating the influence of action execution. It covers three complementary dimensions, spanning 16 subclasses and 699 curated samples. Extensive evaluation of 28 VLMs reveals room for improvement, with even the strongest model achieving only 75.0% accuracy. We further find that model scaling generally improves these capabilities. Ablation studies also indicate larger models show increasing potential as high-level planners. Overall, Plan-Bench provides a lightweight probe for evaluating VLMs' reasoning and planning capabilities relevant to embodied environments and assessing their potential as decision makers for physical tasks. Our benchmark and code are available at https://github.com/MinneFeng/Plan-Bench.

摘要（中文）：视觉语言模型（VLMs）在视觉感知和空间推理方面展现出强劲性能，引发了将其用作具身智能高层规划器的日益浓厚的兴趣。然而，物理任务要求模型整合空间信息、对时间状态进行推理，并在各种约束条件下生成多步骤计划，这引发了一个问题：当前视觉语言模型能否在脱离执行的情况下可靠地支持此类推理与规划。我们提出了Plan-Bench，一个用于评估视觉语言模型在具身世界相关的高层推理和多步骤规划能力的基准，同时隔离动作执行的影响。该基准涵盖三个互补维度，涉及16个子类和699个精选样本。对28个视觉语言模型的大量评估显示其仍有提升空间，即使最强模型也仅达到75.0%的准确率。我们进一步发现，模型规模的扩增通常能提升这些能力。消融研究还表明，较大模型作为高层规划器的潜力日益显现。总体而言，Plan-Bench提供了一个轻量级探针，用于评估视觉语言模型在具身环境相关的推理与规划能力，并评估其作为物理任务决策者的潜力。我们的基准和代码可在 https://github.com/MinneFeng/Plan-Bench 获取。

Authors: Juntong Feng, Qingan Liu, Jingru Dong, Yue Zhu, Weiming Zheng, Yujie Cheng, Xinzhe Han, Shuai Hao, Yunzhi Zhuge, Haiwen Diao, Huchuan Lu

MemAct: Streaming Spatial Understanding with Memory and Active Exploration Other

streaming spatial understanding active exploration memory-augmented VLM counterfactual action optimization embodied agents

简要说明：MemAct是一种用于具身代理流式空间理解的框架，结合记忆写入/检索、主动探索和反事实动作优化于统一的VLM推理循环中，在MemAct-bench上优于基线。

TLDR: MemAct is a framework for streaming spatial understanding in embodied agents, combining memory writing/retrieval, active exploration, and counterfactual action optimization in a unified VLM reasoning loop, outperforming baselines on its MemAct-bench.

Abstract: Spatial understanding is essential for embodied agents navigating and interacting with the physical world. As observations arrive incrementally, agents must reason in a streaming manner. Yet streaming understanding must also be closed-loop: task-relevant evidence may require both recalling past observations and actively acquiring new views. Existing streaming approaches largely emphasize processing incoming observations, leaving task-driven active exploration underexplored. We introduce MemAct, a framework for streaming spatial understanding with memory and action. A shared vision--language model incrementally writes structured historical memory, retrieves records and past frames on demand, and acquires additional evidence through movement and turning. Retrieved evidence and action observations inform subsequent decisions, enabling the agent to continue exploring or answer within a unified reasoning loop. We develop the MemAct suite, a data generation pipeline and collection across real and simulated environments, with approximately 1M training examples for spatial reasoning, memory writing, retrieval, and exploration. Its MemAct-bench comprises 20,000 main QA pairs evaluating current-observation understanding, historical evidence use, and active exploration, plus 2,000 separate Timing questions. MemAct combines supervised fine-tuning for memory and interaction with counterfactual action optimization using cumulative evidence gains, action costs, and terminal answer quality to improve exploration and stopping decisions. Experiments show that MemAct outperforms existing spatial understanding and streaming baselines and approaches frontier multimodal models on MemAct-bench while retaining streaming inference efficiency.

摘要（中文）：空间理解对于具身智能体在物理世界中的导航与交互至关重要。由于观测数据是逐步到达的，智能体必须以流式方式推理。然而，流式理解也必须是闭环的：与任务相关的证据既可能需要回顾过去的观测，也需要主动获取新的视角。现有的流式方法主要侧重于处理传入的观测，而任务驱动的主动探索尚未得到充分研究。我们提出了MemAct，一个结合记忆与动作的流式空间理解框架。一个共享的视觉-语言模型增量式地写入结构化历史记忆，按需检索记录和过去的帧，并通过移动和转向获取额外证据。检索到的证据和动作观测为后续决策提供信息，使智能体能够在统一的推理循环中继续探索或回答问题。我们开发了MemAct套件，包括一个数据生成流水线和跨真实及模拟环境的数据集，包含约100万个训练样本，涵盖空间推理、记忆写入、检索和探索。其MemAct基准测试包含20，000个主要问答对，评估当前观测理解、历史证据使用和主动探索，以及2，000个独立的时间问题。MemAct将监督微调用于记忆和交互，并结合基于累积证据增益、动作成本和最终答案质量的反事实动作优化，以改进探索和停止决策。实验表明，MemAct在MemAct基准上优于现有的空间理解和流式基线方法，并接近前沿多模态模型的性能，同时保持了流式推理的效率。

Authors: Yuxi Wei, Wei Huang, Qirui Chen, Lu Hou, Xiaojuan Qi

Collaborative Planning for UAV-UGV Teams under Operational Constraints via Masked Error-bounded Neuro-Symbolic Diffusion Other

UAV-UGV planning masked diffusion neuro-symbolic error-bounded inference collaborative planning

简要说明：MEND 将无人机-无人车协同规划建模为条件掩码生成过程，并通过神经符号约束和误差有界推理调度，在仿真和实物测试中提升操作约束下的合规性与最优性。

TLDR: MEND formulates collaborative UAV-UGV planning as a conditional masked generative process with neuro-symbolic constraints and error-bounded inference scheduling, improving compliance and optimality under operational constraints in simulation and physical tests.

Abstract: Collaborative planning under operational constraints is essential for heterogeneous robot teams in large-scale missions. Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) provide rapid area coverage but are limited by onboard energy, while Unmanned Ground Vehicles (UGVs) can serve as mobile recharging stations yet are constrained by road-network traversability. Effective collaboration must enforce operational constraints during execution while enabling parallel, coordinated actions. Masked Diffusion Models (MDMs) have shown promise through token unmasking but have two key limitations: entropy-guided scheduling assumes distributional alignment and reliance on differentiable constraints for diffusion-time optimization. We propose Masked Error-bounded Neuro-Symbolic Diffusion (MEND), which formulates collaborative planning as a conditional masked generative process to generate context-aware action sequences for UAV-UGV teams. MEND introduces a neuro-symbolic diffusion paradigm that constrains conditional masked diffusion policies at execution by reweighting the learned action distribution with a logic-induced admissibility indicator, thereby enforcing compliance with operational constraints. MEND introduces an error-bounded inference scheduling at execution that constructs the unmasking schedule by selecting positions with minimal predictive entropy over the constraint-aware action distribution, enhancing collaborative planning optimality under operational constraints. Extensive experimental results in simulation, on real-world maps, and with physical robot teams demonstrate that MEND advances UAV-UGV collaborative planning under operational constraints.

摘要（中文）：在操作约束下的协同规划对于大规模任务中的异构机器人团队至关重要。无人机（UAV）能够提供快速的区域覆盖，但受到机载能量的限制，而无人地面车辆（UGV）可作为移动充电站，却受限于道路网络的可通行性。有效的协同必须在执行过程中强制执行操作约束，同时支持并行、协调的行动。掩码扩散模型（MDMs）已通过令牌去掩码展现出潜力，但存在两个关键局限：基于熵的调度假设分布对齐，以及依赖可微约束进行扩散时优化。我们提出了掩码误差有界神经符号扩散（MEND），将协同规划建模为条件掩码生成过程，以生成无人机-无人地面车辆团队的情境感知行动序列。MEND引入了一种神经符号扩散范式，通过用逻辑诱导的可接受性指示器对学习到的动作分布进行重新加权，在执行阶段约束条件掩码扩散策略，从而确保符合操作约束。MEND在执行阶段引入了误差有界推理调度，通过在约束感知的动作分布上选择预测熵最小的位置来构建去掩码调度，从而在操作约束下提升协同规划的最优性。在仿真、真实地图以及物理机器人团队上的大量实验结果表明，MEND在操作约束下推动了无人机-无人地面车辆协同规划的进步。

Authors: Zihao Deng, Qianhuang Li, Maggie Wigness, John Rogers, Donghyun Kim, Hao Zhang

Mobility-Budget-Constrained Submodular Maximization for Distributed Semantic Multi-Robot Exploration Other

multi-robot exploration semantic mapping budget-constrained path planning submodular maximization distributed coordination

简要说明：本文提出了一种分布式语义多机器人探索框架，结合Dirichlet映射、预算受限轨迹选择和资源感知贪心协调算法，在移动性约束下平衡信息增益，并在仿真中提高了覆盖率和语义精度。

TLDR: This paper introduces a distributed semantic multi-robot exploration framework that uses Dirichlet mapping, budget-constrained trajectory selection, and a resource-aware greedy coordination algorithm to balance information gain with mobility constraints, achieving improved coverage and semantic accuracy in simulations.

Abstract: Multi-robot exploration under communication and mobility constraints requires balancing information gain with reachability. We present a distributed semantic exploration framework that combines Dirichlet mapping, budget-constrained trajectory selection, and Resource-Aware distributed Greedy (RAG) coordination. Each robot clusters frontiers, computes terrain- and heading-aware least-cost paths with a single budget-limited Dijkstra search, and selects feasible paths by marginal information gain, represented by the expected reduction in Dirichlet entropy. Each robot's per-round selection is exact, the team's joint per-round information gain is at least half the centralized optimum, and the bound degrades gracefully under limited communication. Ten-run gridworld ablations show improved coverage, semantic mIoU, and map certainty with lower entropy and traversal cost per unit distance than shortest-distance frontier selection. Budget-sensitivity experiments show that an intermediate budget best balances path reach and receding-horizon execution. In photorealistic full-system simulation against five coordination rules run in their native published forms, the proposed method attains the highest mean coverage and semantic accuracy while being the only one that respects the per-trajectory mobility budget.

摘要（中文）：在通信与移动性约束下的多机器人探索任务中，需在信息增益与可达性之间寻求平衡。我们提出了一种分布式语义探索框架，该框架融合了狄利克雷映射、预算受限的轨迹选择以及资源感知的分布式贪心（RAG）协调机制。每个机器人对前沿进行聚类，通过单次预算受限的Dijkstra搜索计算考虑地形与航向的最小代价路径，并依据边际信息增益（以狄利克雷熵的预期减少量表示）选择可行路径。每个机器人每轮的选择是精确的，团队每轮联合信息增益至少达到集中式最优值的一半，且在通信受限条件下该界会优雅退化。十次网格世界消融实验表明，相较于最短距离前沿选择方法，本方法在覆盖率、语义mIoU和地图确定性方面均有提升，同时降低了熵值和单位距离的遍历代价。预算敏感性实验显示，中等预算能够在路径可达性与滚动时域执行之间达到最佳平衡。在与五种以原始发表形式运行的协调规则进行的光照逼真全系统仿真对比中，所提方法在平均覆盖率和语义精度上均达到最高，并且是唯一满足每条轨迹移动性预算的方法。

Authors: Changxuan Yao, Sandilya Sai Garimella, Lu Gan, Panagiotis Tsiotras

Reference Wording Shapes Retrieval of Robot Task Instructions Manipulation

robot task retrieval lexical rankers TF-IDF BM25 RLBench

简要说明：本文分析了参考措辞的选择如何影响机器人任务指令的检索，在RLBench上比较了词法排序器，并显示字符n-gram TF-IDF表现最佳。

TLDR: This paper analyzes how the choice of reference wording affects retrieval of robot task instructions, comparing lexical rankers on RLBench and showing that character n-gram TF-IDF performs best.

Abstract: Identifying a robot task from a short instruction is sensitive to which descriptions are available for retrieval. We investigate this effect in the natural-language instructions included with the RLBench manipulation benchmark. We extract 296 fixed descriptions from 62 publicly available task files and compare five training-free lexical rankers over 80 random choices of one indexed description per task. Exact strings assigned to conflicting task labels are excluded from the primary score. Character n-gram TF-IDF achieves 61.3% mean top-1 accuracy on the resulting held-out instructions, compared with 55.6% for BM25 and 54.9% for word TF-IDF. Across gallery choices, character TF-IDF ranges from 55.2% to 66.8%; its 5th-95th percentile range is 56.9%-64.8%. Adding a second indexed description improves character TF-IDF by 7.0 percentage points on matched queries. These results quantify the influence of reference wording and representation choice on instruction-to-task retrieval under a consistent evaluation protocol.

摘要（中文）：从短指令中识别机器人任务，其效果高度依赖于可供检索的任务描述。本研究在RLBench操作基准所附的自然语言指令中考察了这一影响。我们从62个公开可用的任务文件中提取了296条固定描述，并在每个任务随机选择一条索引描述的条件下，对五种无需训练的词汇排序器进行了80次随机选择的比较。被指派给冲突任务标签的精确字符串被排除在主要评分之外。字符n-gram TF-IDF在留出指令上的平均Top-1准确率达到61.3%，而BM25为55.6%，词级TF-IDF为54.9%。在不同图库选择下，字符TF-IDF的准确率范围为55.2%至66.8%；其第5至第95百分位区间为56.9%至64.8%。增加第二条索引描述后，字符TF-IDF在匹配查询上的准确率提升了7.0个百分点。这些结果在一致的评估协议下，量化了参考措辞和表示选择对指令到任务检索的影响。

Authors: Jahnavi Yelamanchi

Sim4RAD: A MATLAB Toolkit for Design-Phase Sizing, Actuator Selection and URDF-Model Verification of Serial Robotic Arms Other

actuator sizing robot arm design URDF verification dynamic analysis workspace analysis

简要说明：Sim4RAD 是一个 MATLAB 工具箱，用于串联机械臂设计阶段的尺寸确定、执行器选型和基于 URDF 的验证，并在三种肩部/布局配置的七自由度机械臂上进行了演示。

TLDR: Sim4RAD is a MATLAB toolkit for early-stage sizing, actuator selection, and URDF-based verification of serial robotic arms, demonstrated on a 7-DOF arm across three shoulder/layout configurations.

Abstract: Actuator sizing is an early and consequential decision: joint torque and velocity specifications fix the motors, gearboxes and brakes before any CAD model exists. Sim4RAD is a MATLAB toolkit for that phase and for the verification that follows it. It builds a rigid-body model from a handful of parameters, and four analyses supply the specification: a static analysis combining lever-arm sampling with a posture search, giving a rated torque at a chosen payload envelope and a reproducible peak torque; a dynamics pipeline that reshapes a trajectory under one of four constraints, including the actuator torque-speed envelope; a stochastic analysis over many random motions, so a specification rests on a class of motions, not one trajectory; and a workspace and dexterity analysis that separates where the arm can reach from how it can reach there. Replacing the synthesized model by a URDF file turns the same analyses to verification. A 7-DOF anthropomorphic arm is compared in three layouts differing in the shoulder axis order and in whether the last wrist joint is coaxial with the payload. The static demand at half arm length is nearly the same in all three, and it sizes the joints rather than the sampled motion; reordering the shoulder axes leaves the worst-case torque unchanged at 55 N m and the reachable volume within 8 percent. A last wrist joint coaxial with the payload removes its gravity torque, reduces the adjacent wrist joint by almost a third and cuts the last joint demand tenfold in a 5 m/s scan, at the price of dexterity (mean 0.570 to 0.348). The same arm needs 20 to 37 times more torque for a 5 m/s target than for a 2 s motion: the scenario, not the trajectory, must be fixed first. Verification should use the URDF model of the detailed design; the toolkit is available at https://github.com/LasterLi/Sim4RAD.

摘要（中文）：执行器选型是一个早期且影响深远的决策：在CAD模型存在之前，关节扭矩和速度规格便已确定了电机、减速箱和制动器。Sim4RAD是一个MATLAB工具包，专为此阶段及其后的验证工作而设计。它通过少量参数构建刚体模型，并通过四种分析提供设计规格：一是静力学分析，结合力臂采样与姿态搜索，在选定负载包络下给出额定扭矩和可复现的峰值扭矩；二是动力学流程，通过四种约束之一（包括执行器扭矩-速度包络）对轨迹进行整形；三是随机分析，覆盖大量随机运动，使规格基于一类运动而非单条轨迹；四是工作空间与灵巧度分析，将机械臂可达区域与到达方式分开评估。将合成模型替换为URDF文件后，同一套分析便可用于验证。一个7自由度拟人臂在三种布局下进行比较，区别在于肩部轴顺序以及最后一个腕关节是否与负载同轴。在三种布局中，半臂长处的静态需求几乎相同，且该需求决定关节尺寸而非采样运动；调换肩部轴顺序后，最坏情况扭矩保持55 N·m不变，可达体积差异在8%以内。使最后一个腕关节与负载同轴可消除其重力扭矩，使相邻腕关节需求降低近三分之一，并在5 m/s扫描运动中使末关节需求降为十分之一，但代价是灵巧度下降（均值从0.570降至0.348）。同一机械臂实现5 m/s目标所需的扭矩是完成2 s运动的20至37倍：必须先确定工况场景，而非具体轨迹。验证应使用详细设计的URDF模型；该工具包可在https://github.com/LasterLi/Sim4RAD获取。

Order-Consistent Latent Geometry for Reliable Short-Horizon Planning in World Models WorldModel

world models latent planning self-approaching Euclidean distance discrete latent sequences

简要说明：本文为世界模型中的终端欧氏潜在规划提出路径无反转（自逼近）条件，证明离散潜在序列中的锐角弯曲导致候选排序反转，并通过受控实验验证。

TLDR: This paper identifies a pathwise no-reversal condition (self-approachingness) for terminal Euclidean latent planning in world models, proving that acute bends in discrete latent sequences cause candidate-order reversals and validating this with a controlled experiment.

Abstract: Latent planners often rank candidate action sequences by terminal Euclidean distance to a goal latent. Exact agreement with transition distance would make this score ideal, but is stronger than planning requires: along a transition-shortest rollout, the essential requirement is that latent distance does not reverse true transition progress. We show that this pathwise no-reversal requirement is precisely the classical self-approaching condition. To the best of our knowledge, we are the first to identify self-approachingness as a planner-facing compatibility condition for terminal Euclidean latent planning and to connect its violation to an exact finite-horizon candidate-order reversal. Because visual world models predict discrete latent sequences, we analyze their polygonal interpolation. We prove that an acute bend creates a nonempty region in which terminal Euclidean distance ranks a transition-worse candidate ahead of one that makes genuine progress, even under exact rollouts. We further interpret latent dimension as angular capacity through a classical spherical-code bound. A controlled six-branch experiment, including a zero-padded three-dimensional baseline, validates the predicted ordering failure and separates angular arrangement from ambient dimensionality.

摘要（中文）：潜在规划器通常通过候选动作序列到目标潜在表征的终点欧氏距离来对其进行排序。若该距离与转移距离完全一致，则此评分标准是理想的，但这超出了规划所需的强度：沿转移最短轨迹，基本要求是潜在距离不得逆转真实的转移进度。我们证明，这一路径上的无逆转要求恰恰是经典的自接近条件。据我们所知，我们是首个将自接近性视为面向规划器的终端欧氏潜在规划兼容条件，并将其违反与精确的有限视界候选顺序反转联系起来的研究。由于视觉世界模型预测离散潜在序列，我们分析了它们的多边形插值。我们证明，即使在前向精确展开的情况下，一个锐角弯曲也会产生一个非空区域，在该区域内，终端欧氏距离会将转移更差的候选排在真正取得进展的候选之前。我们进一步通过经典的球面码界将潜在维度解释为角度容量。一项受控的六分支实验（包括一个零填充的三维基线）验证了预测的排序失效，并将角度排列与环境维度分离开来。

Authors: Junlin Wu, Wen Fan, Dandan Zhang

AffectWorld: Benchmarking Emotion-Driven Future World Prediction WorldModel

world model benchmark emotion-driven prediction counterfactual reasoning video understanding action tendencies

简要说明：AffectWorld 是一个用于评估世界模型中情绪驱动的未来世界预测的新基准，通过任务和指标测试情绪-行动-世界状态一致性及反事实推理。

TLDR: AffectWorld is a new benchmark for evaluating emotion-driven future world prediction in world models, introducing tasks and metrics to test emotion-action-world state consistency and counterfactual reasoning.

Abstract: The world encompasses both physical environments and human actors. Predicting its evolution requires understanding both physical laws and how emotions shape human actions. However, existing world model benchmarks primarily assess physical plausibility and perceptual quality, leaving emotion-driven world evolution largely untested.We introduce AffectWorld, a benchmark that evaluates the chain Emotion-Action-World State through three tasks: World-State Consistency, Emotion-Action Consistency, and Causal Consistency. It comprises 1,498 everyday video samples annotated with plausible emotions, action tendencies, and atomic world-state constraints. A counterfactual subset of 233 samples tests whether changing an agent's emotion under fixed scene and event conditions yields corresponding changes in actions and consequences. We define eight metrics across the three tasks and an additional counterfactual metric, combining automatic visual assessment with human-calibrated VLM/LLM judgments. Evaluations of five SoTA world models (e.g., Cosmos3) required world-state change scores of 0.100-0.280 and counterfactual emotion sensitivity scores of 0.027-0.070 on a [0, 1] scale. These results reveal substantial gaps in generating the consequences of emotion-driven actions and adapting future predictions to emotional interventions. AffectWorld provides a testbed for advancing world models that capture how emotions shape future physical and social states.

摘要（中文）：世界既包含物理环境，也包含人类行为主体。预测其演变既需要理解物理规律，也需要理解情感如何塑造人类行为。然而，现有的世界模型基准主要评估物理合理性和感知质量，情感驱动的世界演变在很大程度上尚未得到检验。我们引入了 AffectWorld，一个通过三项任务评估“情感—行为—世界状态”链条的基准：世界状态一致性、情感—行为一致性和因果一致性。该基准包含 1，498 个日常视频样本，并标注了合理的情感、行为倾向和原子世界状态约束。其中包含 233 个反事实样本子集，用于测试在场景和事件条件固定的情况下，改变主体的情感是否会产生相应的行为及后果变化。我们在这三项任务上定义了八项指标，外加一项反事实指标，将自动视觉评估与经人工校准的 VLM/LLM 判断相结合。对五种最先进世界模型（如 Cosmos3）的评估结果显示，在 [0， 1] 尺度上，世界状态变化得分为 0.100—0.280，反事实情感敏感性得分为 0.027—0.070。这些结果揭示了当前模型在生成情感驱动行为后果以及使未来预测适应情感干预方面存在显著不足。AffectWorld 为推进能够捕捉情感如何塑造未来物理和社会状态的世界模型提供了一个测试平台。
